title: AutoCAD 2D Drafter — LV Switchboard Drawing Packs to Client Standard (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
ABOUT US



We are a sheet-metal fabrication and modular building company based in Perth, Western Australia. We design and build prefabricated equipment rooms - complete modular buildings fitted out with switchboards, UPS and battery systems, HVAC, lighting and cabling - which are built in our workshop and delivered to site.



THE ROLE - READ THIS PART CAREFULLY



This is a production drafting role, working to a major infrastructure client's fixed standard. You are NOT designing from a blank sheet.



Our client issues a set of approved "typical" A1 drawings. Every building we deliver needs its own site-specific version of that set. Your job is to take the typical sheet, substitute the real asset tags, fill in the equipment property tables, update the cross-references to other sheets, and issue a clean, correct, revision-controlled pack.



We have roughly 40 buildings to deliver over the next two to three years, at 10-15 drawings each. We want one person who owns this and gets fast at it.



THE FOUR THINGS THAT ACTUALLY MATTER



1. Propagating a typical to site-specific WITHOUT introducing a tag error. The typical carries placeholders. You replace them with the real tags and fill the property table under each board - form of separation, rated current, rated voltage, short-circuit withstand, degree of protection. Get one wrong and it can be copied across 40 buildings.



2. Drawing form of separation correctly. Form 4b segregated areas are DRAWN - shaded regions with segregation barriers shown - not just written in a note. If this sentence means nothing to you, this job is not for you yet.



3. Cross-sheet reference integrity. Sheets refer to each other constantly ("see drawing XX for relay R2", "refer to note 26"). When a sheet changes, the references have to keep up.



4. Revision and title block discipline. Multi-row revision tables with designed / drawn / checked / approved columns, document review numbers, revision clouds and triangles, and the CAD pathname carried in the footer. Boring, and the whole job depends on it.



WHAT IS ON THE SHEETS



Block diagrams; supply schematics for single and three phase; transformer and standby generator supply arrangements with automatic load bank; automatic supply changeover systems; UPS systems with external maintenance bypass; distribution board schematics; switchboard front elevations with escutcheons, current transformers, gland plates and isolators; label and nameplate schedules; earthing and bonding general arrangements. Sheets carry 25-30 numbered notes referencing the client's technical specifications.



WHAT YOU ARE NOT DOING



You are not the design engineer. Maximum demand, fault level and protection coordination are done by our engineering team and handed to you as inputs. You turn approved design intent into accurate, consistent, issue-ready drawings.



ESSENTIAL



- Strong 2D AutoCAD. This work is plain AutoCAD DWG - layers, blocks, attributed title blocks, external references. That is the whole toolset.

- You have personally drafted switchboard, distribution board or power distribution drawings and can show us the NATIVE DWG FILES, not just PDFs.

- You have worked to someone else's drawing standard - a client template, a company CAD manual, a title block you did not design.

- You can read a specification and a schedule and spot where they contradict the drawing.

- Careful and consistent on repetitive work. This is the core of the job.

- Good written English. You raise questions early instead of guessing.

- Reliable internet and a PC that runs AutoCAD properly.

- Able to work 8am to 5pm Perth time (AWST, GMT+8) - the same as Philippine time.



NOT REQUIRED



- AutoCAD Electrical. We do not use it. Plain AutoCAD only.

- An engineering degree. We care what you can draw.

- Australian standards knowledge. We will teach you ours.



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with multi-sheet drawing packs issued for client review and approval

- Any document or revision control system (Autodesk Vault, ProjectWise, or similar)

- Experience taking marked-up PDFs and working the markups back into the DWG



WHAT WE OFFER



- Full-time, long-term, salaried. This program runs for years.

- Paid Philippine holidays and a 13th month.

- Direct work with our engineering manager - no agency in between.

- Annual review.



RATE



$800 - $1,150 per month depending on experience. Tell us your expected monthly rate.



HOW TO APPLY - APPLICATIONS THAT SKIP THIS ARE DELETED UNREAD



1. Put the word ESCUTCHEON at the very top of your message.



2. Send 2-3 drawings you personally drafted, AS DWG FILES (Google Drive or Dropbox link). PDFs alone will not be assessed - we need to see your layers, blocks and title block. Black out client names if you need to. Tell us exactly which parts were your work.



3. Answer this in your own words, from your own experience - do not use AI to answer it: You are given an approved typical drawing and told to produce site-specific versions of it for 40 different buildings. Describe the actual steps you would take, and tell us where you think mistakes are most likely to creep in.



4. Tell us the last time you worked to a client's drawing standard rather than your own. What was the standard, and what did you find hardest about it?



5. Your AutoCAD version, your available start date, and the hours you can work in Perth time.



Shortlisted applicants get a short PAID test: we give you one typical sheet and a page of site data, and you produce the site-specific version. About three to four hours. We pay for it whether or not we hire you.

title: ETERNAL SWORD PACT GAMING VA [MMORPG]
description:
Position: Part-Time Gaming Virtual Assistant

Game: Eternal Sword Pact (Mobile MMORPG)

Starting Pay: $2 USD/hour (paid trial)

Future Pay: $2–$3+ USD/hour based on performance

Workload: 3–8 hours daily (typically 3–5 hours)

Location: Remote / Worldwide

Schedule: Flexible, Melbourne, Australia time

Employment: Long-term opportunity



1. About the Role



I’m looking for a reliable virtual assistant to help manage my Eternal Sword Pact account while I’m offline.



Your main responsibilities are completing daily quests, collecting rewards, upgrading my character and monitoring AFK gameplay.



Most activities are straightforward and don’t require constant attention. The game is easy to navigate, with red notification dots indicating available upgrades, fusions and rewards.



On a typical day, completing all routine activities should take approximately 3–5 hours, although some days may require up to 8 hours.



Previous Eternal Sword Pact experience is highly preferred, although experience with similar mobile MMORPGs is also welcome.



I’m looking for someone reliable, honest and interested in a long-term arrangement.



2. Daily Quests & Dungeons



Complete all available routine daily quests and dungeon attempts, including:



* Advancement Dungeon

* Ancient Vein

* Ancient Ruins

* Spirit Spring Trove

* Road to Immortal

* Time Realm

* Dimensional Trace

* Kunlun Mirage

* Multiplayer Dungeon

* EXP Dungeon

* Chaotic Realm

* Guild Ranch

* Verdure Shrine

* Mirage Arcadia

* Alliance Hunt

* Star Level Arcadia

* Dragonbane Platform

* Sea Palace Arcadia

* Celestial Peak

* Love Game

* Fame Quest



Scheduled Activities (When Available)



* Immortal Grave

* Northern Abyss

* Tracing the Vast Sea

* Sacred Mountain Realm



Some activities are only available on certain days or require specific server conditions. Complete them when accessible.



Prioritise completing all available daily attempts and collecting every reward.



3. CRITICAL: Dungeon Attempts & Merge Rules



These instructions are extremely important and must always be followed.



Always Maximise Daily Attempts



For daily quests and dungeons:



* Always purchase additional attempts using ingots when available.

* Maximise the number of attempts for every eligible daily dungeon.

* Never use jade or coupons to purchase additional attempts.

* Complete all available attempts before finishing the activity.

* Claim all available rewards and treasure chests after each run.



For example, Multiplayer Dungeon may initially provide 2–3 attempts, with additional attempts available for purchase using ingots.



Always purchase the extra attempts to reach the maximum, such as 6 total attempts.



NEVER Merge Dungeon Attempts



Do not merge attempts for any daily dungeon except EXP Dungeon.



Merging attempts can result in fewer rewards and valuable items.



For example:



Multiplayer Dungeon



* Purchase all additional attempts using ingots.

* If 6 attempts are available, complete all 6 individually.

* Never merge the 6 attempts into 1 run.

* Open and claim the treasure chest rewards from each individual run.



This rule applies to every other daily dungeon that offers merging.



ONLY Exception: EXP Dungeon



EXP Dungeon is the only activity where merging attempts is permitted.



For EXP Dungeon:



* Purchase all additional attempts using ingots.

* Maximise the available attempts.

* You may merge the attempts into 1 run.

* Collect all EXP and available rewards.



Summary: Maximise attempts with ingots, never merge except EXP Dungeon, and always claim every treasure chest.



4. Alliance Quests



Complete available Alliance Quest objectives, including:



* Complete 20 loops of Fame

* Participate in Immortal Arena

* Complete Guild Sprite

* Participate in Mount Advancement Dungeon

* Participate in Mirage Arcadia



Collect all available Alliance Quest rewards.



Only complete routine participation requirements. Major competitive events are not required.



5. Character & Equipment Improvements



Alongside daily quests, you are responsible for improving my character as much as possible using available resources.



Regularly check the Improve menu and complete available upgrades, including:



* Gear Crafting

* Gear Refinement

* Improve Rune

* Improve Spirit

* Improve Holywar

* Improve Spiritus

* Improve Mount

* Improve Outfit



Also check the following menus for available upgrades and improvements:



* Gear

* Spirit

* Character

* Advance

* Assistance

* Zodiac

* Guild

* Bag



Prioritise upgrades that increase character combat power and overall progression.



Use available materials efficiently and avoid wasting valuable resources.



6. Red Notifications & Upgrades



The game is very easy to navigate.



Most available upgrades, fusions and rewards are indicated by red notification dots throughout the interface.



Your responsibilities include:



* Check all red notification dots regularly.

* Follow notifications to available upgrades and improvements.

* Fuse available materials.

* Upgrade equipment, spirits, mounts, outfits, runes and other character attributes.

* Collect free rewards.

* Use available resources to maximise character progression.

* Repeat until all relevant improvements are completed.



Not every red notification requires action.



Skip shops, paid offers, special events and anything requiring unauthorised spending.



The goal is to complete daily quests, clear relevant red notifications and maximise character progression every day.



7. Strict In-Game Spending Rules



These rules are extremely important and must always be followed.



Coupons



NEVER spend coupons under any circumstances.



Jade



Jade may ONLY be spent on direct equipment refinement improvements.



Permitted examples:



* Purchasing additional refinement materials when prompted during gear refinement.

* Buying refinement scrolls directly through the gear refinement interface.

* Spending 80–100 jade on refinement materials when prompted during an approved refinement upgrade.



Jade must NEVER be spent on:



* General shops

* Trade shops or markets

* VIP shops or events

* Divine Compass

* Special events

* Lottery systems

* Additional dungeon attempts

* Cosmetics

* Other premium purchases



Never exchange coupons for jade.



If a purchase is not clearly a direct gear refinement improvement, do not spend jade.



Ingots & Copper



Ingots and copper may be used for reasonable routine upgrades, improvements and daily progression.



Always use ingots to purchase additional attempts for eligible daily dungeons until the maximum number of attempts is reached.



Avoid unnecessary purchases outside these approved activities.



Real Money



Never spend real money or make unauthorised purchases.



If unsure about any purchase, stop and ask me first.



8. Divine Compass & Spinning Rules



NEVER spin Divine Compass wheels.



NEVER use Fortune Vouchers for any spins, draws or events.



Additional rules:



* Other free spins and draws are permitted.

* Spins using ingots or copper are allowed where reasonable.

* Never spend jade or coupons on spins or draws.

* Never use Fortune Vouchers, even if they are already available in the account.

* If unsure which currency a spin requires, skip it.



Fortune Vouchers must always be saved unless I explicitly approve otherwise.



9. Events That Are NOT Required



You are not required to participate in major scheduled competitive events, including:



* Alliance War

* Immortal Ruins

* Celestial Realm

* Major PvP events

* Competitive guild battles

* Other scheduled events requiring active coordination



I’ll personally handle these activities.



Routine daily participation in Immortal Arena is permitted when required for Alliance Quests, using free attempts only.



Do not sacrifice daily quest completion to participate in major events.



10. Working Hours & Availability



Preferred hours: 4:00 AM – 11:00 AM Melbourne time.



Flexible availability: 4:00 AM – 2:30 PM Melbourne time.



Expected gameplay is approximately 3–8 hours daily.



Most days should take no longer than 5 hours to complete routine activities.



Some days may require additional time for upgrades and progression.



You do not need to work the entire availability window.



All regular gameplay must finish by 2:30 PM, as I have personal events beginning around 3:00 PM and 3:30 PM.



Additional Flexibility



Some days I may take a break from playing or be unavailable throughout the day.



When this happens, I’ll communicate with you in advance and let you know if you can continue playing outside your usual schedule.



Additional hours can be arranged through mutual agreement.



Never log into my account outside agreed hours without permission.



Only actual working hours are paid, excluding completely unattended AFK time. Periods requiring active monitoring may count as working time as agreed.



11. Social Interaction Rules



Please avoid unnecessary interaction with other players.



* Do not initiate conversations.

* Avoid guild chat, world chat and private conversations.

* Do not share account information or personal details.

* Do not argue or engage in social activities.

* Do not make commitments on my behalf.



If someone messages my character, you may simply respond:



“hey, this is lexi’s sister. lexi is offline at the moment 😊”



There is no need to continue the conversation.



My character name is Lexi.



12. Pay & Opportunities



Starting rate: $2 USD/hour during the paid trial.



Following a successful trial, the rate may increase to $2–$3 USD/hour.



Further increases may be offered over time based on:



* Reliability and consistency

* Knowledge of Eternal Sword Pact

* Daily quest completion

* Efficiency and character progression

* Following instructions and spending restrictions

* Good communication



I’m looking for someone dependable who can potentially work with me long-term.



Compensation will be agreed in advance and must comply with applicable employment and platform requirements.



13. Ideal Candidate



* Preferably already plays Eternal Sword Pact.

* Experienced with mobile MMORPGs.

* Familiar with AFK gameplay and daily quests.

* Reliable internet connection.

* Compatible phone, tablet or emulator.

* Available during Melbourne morning hours.

* Basic written English communication.

* Honest, responsible and detail-oriented.

* Comfortable following daily checklists.

* Able to work independently after training.

* Willing to learn the game’s progression systems.



14. Daily Reporting



At the end of each shift, please send a short summary:



Eternal Sword Pact Daily Report



Date:

Hours worked:

Daily quests completed:

Dungeon attempts completed:

Character improvements:

Jade spent on refinements:

Coupons spent: 0

Fortune Vouchers spent: 0

Any issues encountered:



Nothing complicated. Just a quick update so I know everything is progressing.



15. How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



1. Have you played Eternal Sword Pact before? If yes, what server and character level?

2. What other mobile MMORPGs have you played?

3. Are you available between 4:00 AM and 2:30 PM Melbourne time?

4. Do you have a device capable of running the game reliably?

5. Are you comfortable starting with a paid trial at $2 USD/hour?



Bonus: If you currently play Eternal Sword Pact, please include a screenshot of your character.



I’m looking for someone reliable, easy to communicate with and interested in a long-term position.



16. Overall Objective



Your job is to:



1. Complete all available daily quests and dungeons.

2. Purchase all additional daily dungeon attempts using ingots.

3. Complete every dungeon attempt individually. Never merge, except EXP Dungeon.

4. Open every available treasure chest and collect all rewards.

5. Complete Alliance Quests and scheduled activities when available.

6. Follow relevant red notifications and perform character upgrades.

7. Maximise character progression without wasting premium currencies.

8. Never spend coupons or Fortune Vouchers.

9. Only spend jade on approved gear refinement improvements.

10. Avoid unnecessary social interactions and major scheduled events.

11. Communicate clearly and finish before my scheduled gameplay.



Use the game’s AFK features whenever appropriate.



The goal is to maximise daily rewards, materials and character progression while I’m offline, without wasting valuable resources.

 delivery, then carry out approved fixes

title: Amazon Troubleshooting Expert
description:
Position Overview



We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Amazon Troubleshooting Specialist to manage, diagnose, and resolve issues affecting Amazon seller accounts, product listings, orders, inventory, payments, and overall marketplace performance.



The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to investigate complex account and listing issues while working within Amazon’s policies and guidelines.



Key Responsibilities

* Monitor and troubleshoot issues within Amazon Seller Central, including account, listing, inventory, order, payment, and performance-related problems.

* Investigate and resolve listing suppressions, stranded inventory, inactive listings, ASIN issues, category restrictions, and product detail page errors.

* Diagnose account health issues, including policy warnings, performance notifications, intellectual property complaints, authenticity concerns, and other account-related restrictions.

* Prepare and submit appeals, Plans of Action (POAs), and case responses to Amazon Seller Support.

* Follow up on unresolved Amazon cases and escalate issues when necessary.

* Troubleshoot FBA-related issues, including receiving discrepancies, inventory adjustments, stranded inventory, removals, reimbursements, and fulfillment problems.

* Investigate order and customer-related issues, including cancellations, refunds, returns, delivery problems, and order defects.

* Identify and resolve product listing and catalog issues, including incorrect attributes, variations, images, titles, descriptions, and product information.

* Review Amazon account metrics and identify potential issues that may negatively affect seller performance.

* Maintain accurate records of troubleshooting activities, Amazon cases, resolutions, and follow-up actions.

* Coordinate with internal teams such as operations, catalog, customer service, inventory, and management to resolve marketplace issues.

* Stay updated on Amazon policies, Seller Central changes, marketplace requirements, and best practices.

* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements to prevent future problems.

* Provide clear status updates and communicate complex Amazon issues in an easy-to-understand manner.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting Amazon FBA and FBM accounts.

Experience handling account suspensions, listing removals, policy violations, and intellectual property complaints.

Knowledge of Amazon Brand Registry and catalog management.

Experience with Amazon reimbursement claims and FBA inventory investigations.

Familiarity with Amazon advertising and how listing/account issues can affect advertising performance.

Experience working with multiple Amazon marketplaces such as the US, UK, Canada, Australia, or Europe.

Experience using Amazon Seller Central reports and third-party Amazon seller tools.







Work Schedule



* Full-time

* May require flexibility during major sales campaigns, product launches, and livestream events.



What We Offer



* Competitive salary

* Career growth opportunities

* Training and professional development

* Collaborative and innovative work environment

title: Scaffolding / Temporary Works Design Engineer
description:
As a Scaffolding Design Engineer / Temporary Works Design Engineer, you will be responsible for providing remote engineering design support to an Australian client delivering scaffolding and temporary works across Western Australian projects, ensuring every design is safe, buildable, technically sound and compliant with relevant Australian Standards.



This role plays a key part in preparing structural calculations, engineering assessments and detailed drawings for scaffolds and other temporary structures, modelling and checking structural stability, managing drawing revisions, and preparing complete design packages for client review, verification and approval.



The successful candidate will be a registered civil engineer with strong scaffolding or temporary works design experience, and will demonstrate a high level of technical accuracy, safety awareness, attention to detail, organisation and accountability.



Reporting



This position reports directly to the Director or designated Management Representative, with day-to-day technical direction from the client’s nominated engineering lead.



Duties and Responsibilities



Scaffold & Temporary Works Design



Design scaffolds and temporary works, including independent, birdcage, cantilever, suspended, hanging and mobile scaffolds, loading bays, access towers, edge protection and propping

Prepare structural calculations covering dead, live and wind loads, load combinations, member forces, connection and coupler capacities, ties, bracing and base support

Carry out structural modelling and stability assessments using STAAD.Pro, SAP2000, Autodesk Robot or equivalent software

Assess supporting structures and ground conditions, including slabs, steelwork, plant structures and foundations, and specify required load distribution or propping

Design using proprietary scaffold systems and tube-and-coupler arrangements in line with manufacturer data and approved configurations.

Engineering Drawings & Documentation



Produce detailed 2D scaffold and temporary works engineering drawings in AutoCAD, including plans, elevations, sections, tie and anchor layouts, and load notes

Develop 3D models and support BIM coordination in Autodesk Revit where required

Prepare design packages (calculations, drawings, design basis and assumptions) for independent verification and sign-off by the client’s nominated Australian engineer where required

Manage drawing revisions, transmittals and document control in line with client procedures.

Standards Compliance & Design Review



Interpret and apply relevant Australian Standards, including the AS/NZS 1576 scaffolding series, AS/NZS 4576 scaffolding guidelines and AS/NZS 1170 structural design actions

Check designs and calculations against client specifications, site constraints and applicable WA work health and safety requirements

Review existing scaffold and temporary works designs and recommend modifications where loading, configuration or site conditions change

Respond to design queries, review comments and requests for information (RFIs) promptly and accurately.

Project Support & Coordination



Work with the client’s project, site and safety teams to understand scope, access requirements, sequencing and constraints

Support projects across mining, oil and gas, commercial construction, marine and industrial environments, including shutdown and maintenance work

Provide design input for tenders, quotations and material take-offs when requested

Escalate design risks, unclear inputs or time-sensitive issues appropriately.

Quality, Records & Confidentiality



Maintain accurate records of design inputs, assumptions, revisions and approvals for audit readiness and traceability

Ensure engineering files and client information are securely stored and appropriately accessed

Follow applicable company and client requirements relating to information security and confidentiality

Assist with engineering-related projects and other duties as required.

Skills



Strong knowledge and practical experience in scaffolding and temporary works design

Sound understanding of structural analysis, load combinations, stability and connection design

Demonstrated ability to interpret Australian engineering standards and produce designs suitable for Australian project review and approval

AutoCAD (Essential): produce detailed 2D scaffold engineering drawings and revisions

STAAD.Pro (Highly desirable): structural analysis, member forces and load combinations

SAP2000 (Highly desirable): structural modelling and stability assessments

Autodesk Revit (Desirable): 3D modelling and BIM coordination

Autodesk Robot (Desirable): structural analysis and design

Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in calculations and drawings

Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet project and shutdown deadlines

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including clear technical reporting

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.

Qualifications



Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering

Current Philippine Professional Civil Engineer registration with the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), particularly given the role’s independent design calculations and engineering assessments

Minimum 5 years’ engineering experience (5–8 years preferred), including at least 3 years in scaffolding or temporary works design

Experience with proprietary scaffold systems commonly used in Australia is advantageous

Experience delivering engineering designs remotely for Australian or other international clients is highly regarded

Proficient in the effective, responsible, and productive use of AI-powered tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, or similar technologies) to improve documentation and efficiency, while independently checking all engineering outputs and maintaining accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance.

Preferred Project Experience



Experience supporting the following project environments in Western Australia would be particularly valuable:



Mining operations and shutdowns, including processing plants and conveyor systems

Oil and gas facilities, LNG plants and refineries

Commercial construction and high-rise developments

Marine infrastructure, ports and wharves

Industrial maintenance and major infrastructure projects.

Desired Personal Qualities



Safety-focused, with a clear understanding that temporary works design errors can lead to serious harm

Strong analytical and critical thinking skills

Methodical and accurate, with calculations and assumptions documented so others can check them

Highly proactive and able to take initiative in solving technical challenges

Strong sense of accountability and ownership of design quality

Able to identify and escalate design risks appropriately

Ability to work under pressure and meet tight shutdown and project deadlines without compromising quality

Comfortable working remotely with an Australian team and adapting to client processes

Professional and approachable communication style

Team-oriented and collaborative.

Benefits:





Health insurance

Pay raise

title: CPA / Tax Accountant for a Returning Professional with Foreign Consultancy Income (Freelance, Project-Based)
description:
About the role

I'm a Filipino professional who has just moved back to the Philippines after many years working abroad. I have signed a cross-border consultancy agreement with a company based in Saudi Arabia, and I'll be working on it from here. I need a licensed CPA who knows Philippine tax for self-employed people and professionals, especially income earned from foreign clients. You'll help me understand my obligations, plan the most tax-efficient setup that is still fully compliant, and handle my filings.

Scope of work

Phase 1: Advisory and computation

Explain my Philippine tax position now that I'm a resident citizen earning foreign-sourced professional income. This includes how to treat the transition year when I moved back from abroad.

Compare the 8% optional income tax rate with the graduated rates plus percentage tax or VAT, and recommend the better option for me.

Explain VAT treatment of services exported to a foreign client, including zero-rating if it applies, and the VAT registration threshold.

Check for any tax withheld in Saudi Arabia on my fees. Advise on foreign tax credits or treaty relief, if any is available.

Compute my maximum net take-home pay under the agreement. This should cover income tax, business taxes, and mandatory SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG contributions as a self-employed member.

Give me a written summary and a simple computation sheet (Excel or Google Sheets).

Phase 2: Registration and compliance

Help me register with the BIR as a self-employed professional: TIN update, Form 1901, Certificate of Registration, invoices, and books of accounts.

Set up a compliance calendar for quarterly and annual returns (e.g. 1701Q, 1701/1701A, 2551Q or VAT returns, as applicable).

Advise on any local government requirements (business or occupational permits) for working from home.

Phase 3: Filing (ongoing)

Prepare and file my quarterly and annual returns through eBIRForms or eFPS.

Keep my records organized and flag deadlines ahead of time.

Requirements

Licensed CPA in the Philippines (please include your PRC license number)

At least 3 years of hands-on experience with tax for self-employed people and professionals

Experience with clients who earn foreign-sourced income: returning OFWs, remote freelancers, or consultants serving overseas clients

Up to date on current BIR rules, including the Ease of Paying Taxes (EOPT) Act changes

Able to explain tax concepts clearly in English or Taglish to someone outside accounting

Willing to sign a confidentiality / NDA agreement

Nice to have

Experience with Middle East clients or GCC withholding tax

Accredited BIR tax agent

Based in or near Laguna / South Luzon for occasional in-person meetings

Compensation

Please quote:

A fixed fee for Phase 1 and 2

A monthly retainer or per-filing rate for Phase 3

title: Agency Operations Manager (Meta Ads)
description:
*Founder's Second-in-Command | The Warm Up Guys**



**Location:** Remote — Philippines  

**Type:** Full-time  

**Compensation:** US$2,000–$2,500 per month, negotiable for exceptional candidates  

**Hours:** Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm Philippine time, with occasional flexibility for deadlines and client needs  

**Leave:** Flexible paid time off, coordinated around business needs and team coverage



## About The Warm Up Guys



The Warm Up Guys is an Australian digital advertising agency helping **US-based comedians, entertainment venues and live-event promoters sell more tickets through Meta advertising**.



We've delivered over 700 advertising campaigns and have a six-person remote team in the Philippines covering campaign delivery, creative production, optimisation, quality assurance, client coordination and marketing automation.



We're also developing our own software and building partnerships to support our next stage of growth.



Our work has real deadlines. If a show happens on Friday, launching its advertising campaign on Saturday isn't an option. Organisation, communication and reliable execution are essential.



We're looking for an experienced **Agency Operations Manager** to help lead our team, strengthen our systems and take ownership of the day-to-day operation of the business.



## The Role



You'll work directly with the founder as our operational second-in-command.



Your responsibility is to ensure the agency runs smoothly: clients are properly looked after, the team knows what needs to happen, quality standards are met, and important work gets completed without constant follow-up.



We're looking for someone who combines three strengths:



- **Exceptional organisation and operational ownership.**

- **Proven experience leading people in a digital marketing agency.**

- **Strong hands-on Meta advertising knowledge.**



This is a senior, hands-on leadership role. You'll have real authority to manage daily operations, improve processes, develop the team and enforce accountability.



We're looking for someone who can identify problems, work out sensible solutions and follow through independently.



## What You'll Own



### 1. Agency Operations & Systems



- Oversee daily operations, priorities, deadlines and outstanding commitments.

- Establish effective meeting routines, reporting, delegation and follow-up processes.

- Keep work organised, assigned and tracked through ClickUp.

- Review and improve existing SOPs, workflows and handovers.

- Identify operational bottlenecks and implement practical improvements.

- Help the agency manage increasing campaign volumes without sacrificing quality.



### 2. Team Leadership



- Manage our six-person remote team, including our existing Delivery Lead and other specialists.

- Run regular one-on-ones, team meetings and performance reviews.

- Establish clear expectations, responsibilities and accountability.

- Identify training needs and help team members develop stronger skills and independent judgment.

- Address performance issues fairly, directly and consistently.



Our **Delivery Lead remains responsible for directing the campaign delivery team and ensuring campaign quality**. You'll manage and support that function while overseeing the wider operation.



### 3. Meta Advertising & Quality Oversight



**Strong practical experience with Meta advertising is essential.**



You must be confident navigating Meta Ads Manager and Business Suite, reviewing campaigns, evaluating performance and identifying potential problems.



You should understand:



- Campaign structures, audiences, targeting and exclusions.

- Budgets, placements and optimisation settings.

- Meta Pixel, conversion tracking and attribution.

- Performance reporting and optimisation.

- Creative testing and advertising strategy.

- Campaign quality assurance.



You won't be expected to personally build or optimise every campaign.



However, you must understand the work well enough to **recognise mistakes, challenge questionable decisions and ensure the appropriate people resolve problems**.



### 4. Client Operations



- Maintain visibility across active client accounts, campaign activity and outstanding commitments.

- Identify clients who need additional attention or may be at risk.

- Coordinate the team to resolve client issues proactively.

- Ensure communication with our US-based clients is accurate, clear and timely.

- Prepare concise account summaries and recommendations for the founder.

- Make sure client commitments are tracked and completed.



The founder will continue handling many key client relationships. Your role is to ensure the operation supporting those relationships is properly managed.



## Your Authority



You'll have the authority to run internal meetings, manage day-to-day priorities, assign work, lead the team, enforce standards and improve operational processes.



You'll work closely with the Delivery Lead on technical delivery procedures. Significant unresolved disagreements will be escalated to the founder.



Major decisions involving hiring, termination, client contracts, pricing and significant expenditure will remain with the founder.



We're looking for someone comfortable making independent decisions, taking responsibility for outcomes and recommending changes when something could work better.



## What We're Looking For



**Essential:**



- Proven experience managing operations or delivery within a digital marketing agency.

- Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads, including campaign management and performance analysis.

- Experience leading remote teams and managing performance.

- Exceptional organisation, prioritisation and follow-through.

- Demonstrated success improving SOPs, workflows and quality-control systems.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong independent judgment and problem-solving ability.



**Nice to have:**



- Experience in an agency specialising in Meta advertising.

- Experience working with US clients and Australian business owners.

- Familiarity with ClickUp, GoHighLevel, automation and AI tools.

- Experience working directly with a founder during a period of growth.



## What Success Looks Like



**First 30 days:** You understand our team, clients and workflows, have visibility over client commitments, and have identified the highest-priority improvements.



**First 60 days:** You're running a consistent operational meeting and reporting structure. Responsibilities are clearer, client follow-through is more reliable, and improvements to existing processes are underway.



**First 90 days:** You're confidently managing day-to-day operations. We can measure improvements in quality, follow-through and operational consistency, and the founder is spending less time chasing information and coordinating work.



We'll establish baseline measures together, including outstanding client commitments, quality issues, overdue work and escalations.



## Why Join The Warm Up Guys?



This is an opportunity to take a senior leadership position in a specialist Australian agency serving the US entertainment market.



You'll work directly with the founder, have meaningful influence over how the business operates, and help develop the people and systems that support our growth.



For the right person, there's an opportunity to take on increasing responsibility as the agency grows.



## How to Apply



To help us identify applicants who've read the full description, **please start your application with the word SHOWTIME**.



Then answer the following questions. We're interested in specific examples from your experience rather than generic answers.



**1. Agency leadership**



Tell us about an agency you've helped manage. How many people did you lead? What were you accountable for? What specific improvements did you make?



**2. Meta advertising knowledge**



A ticket-selling campaign's reported cost per purchase suddenly doubles four days before the event.



Walk us through what you'd investigate, in order, before d
 what action to take.



**3. Process improvement**



Describe a real operational or quality-control problem you discovered and resolved. What was the underlying cause, what did you change, and how did you verify that the improvement worked?



**4. People management**



Tell us about a time you addressed repeated mistakes or poor performance from a team member. What did you do, and what happened afterwards?



**5. Your first two weeks**



You're joining an established agency with a team of six, multiple active clients and existing SOPs.



How would you approach your first two weeks to understand the operation, establish priorities and identify opportunities for improvement?



Please also include:



- Your expected monthly compensation.

- Your availability and earliest possible start date.

- Your CV or LinkedIn profile.



**Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid practical assessment covering Meta advertising and agency operations.**

Warm-transfer interested, qualified prospects directly to our funding specialist.

Previous B2B cold-calling experience.

Reliable computer, headset, high-speed internet, and quiet workspace.



Availability during the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule.

How to Apply

A 60-second English voice recording introducing yourself.

A summary of your previous U.S. cold-calling experience.



Any experience in business financing or financial services.



Confirmation that you can work Tuesday–Thursday, 9 AM–1 PM Eastern Time.

title: Sales Caller (Outbound) for Real Estate Software
description:
Locium is an Australian software platform for real estate photographers, videographers and media studios. It runs the whole job in one place, from booking to photo and video delivery and payment. It's built by the team behind Patorama Studios, a working real estate media company.



We're hiring a Sales Caller to call media studios in Australia and the US, find out how they run their jobs today, and book them into a demo or a free signup.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Make 80 outbound calls a day from our dialler in Locium

- Follow our six-step call script: open, find out, pitch, handle the no, close, wrap up

- Book demos and signups with a set day and time

- Log every call and follow up on our schedule

- Practise with Homie, our AI sales coach, and act on your call scores



PAY

- $4 USD per hour, paid fortnightly by Wise or PayPal

- Plus 1% of everything each client you sign pays us, for as long as they stay your client

- Weekly target bonuses and monthly contests

- Paid training from our remote operations team, and a 6-week ramp before full targets



HOURS

- Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm Australian Eastern time (6am to 2pm Manila time from October to April, 7am to 3pm the rest of the year)

- When you're calling US studios, your hours are staggered to suit US business hours



YOU HAVE

- Clear, confident spoken English

- 1+ year of outbound calling, appointment setting or telesales (B2B or software is a plus)

- A quiet workspace, stable internet with a backup, and a noise-cancelling headset

- The drive to stay curious after a "no" and keep dialling



TO APPLY

Start your application with the words "Locium caller". Then tell us:

1. Your calling experience: what you sold, calls a day, appointments booked a week

2. Your internet speed and your backup connection

3. A link to a 1 to 2 minute voice recording of you opening a cold call to a photography studio



Applications without the code phrase won't be read.

description:

Type: Remote, part-time, ongoing  

Rate: USD, hourly, based on skill set (to be discussed)



 About the Role



I'm looking for an experienced SEO Specialist and Digital Marketing Assistant to handle specific SEO and digital marketing tasks that are not currently covered by my existing team.



The primary focus will be on off-page SEO, local citations, backlink outreach, guest posting, digital PR, social media content creation, and basic photo and video editing.



This is a long-term, part-time position for someone who can work independently, manage multiple responsibilities, meet weekly deliverables, and communicate consistently.



I'm looking for someone who already has hands-on experience and can execute tasks without needing constant supervision or extensive training.



Core Responsibilities



These are the primary responsibilities and expected deliverables for this position.



1. Off-Page SEO & Local Citations

- Audit and update existing business listings against the company's master NAP (Name, Address, Phone Number).

- Correct outdated addresses, phone numbers, business information, and operating hours.

- Manage listings across Google, Bing, Apple, Yelp,
, BBB, Nextdoor, Angi, Houzz, and other relevant directories.

- Research new citation opportunities with a Domain Authority (DA) above 30.

- Submit at least 5 new business listings/citations every week using consistent NAP information.

- Monitor pending listings and follow up on verification requests through
, phone, or postcard.

- Maintain records of submitted, verified, and pending listings and provide screenshots or other proof of completed work.



 2. Guest Posting, Backlink Outreach & Digital PR

- Research relevant guest posting and backlink opportunities, particularly home improvement, landscaping, gardening, real estate, and local publications.

- Find relevant editors, website owners, journalists, and publication contacts.

- Send personalized outreach pitches and follow up with prospects.

- Write guest articles, industry-related content, or contributed columns when needed.

- Look for opportunities to get the company featured in relevant local publications, industry websites, and online magazines.

- Coordinate with the team to request project photos, information, or quotes for articles and features.



Monthly target:

- Aim for at least 2 guest post placements, editorial features, or PR opportunities per month.

- Prioritize relevant, quality websites and publications over random backlinks.

- No paid links or artificial link schemes.



3. Social Media Content Production & Photo/Video Editing

- Create visual content for
, Instagram, and Threads based on the topics and content briefs provided by the existing social media manager.

- Edit short-form videos for Reels and other social media content using CapCut or similar tools.

- Edit photos for social media, including cropping, color correction, resizing, and basic enhancements.

- Add captions, subtitles, background music, transitions, and company branding to videos when appropriate.

- Turn raw project photos and video clips provided by the team into polished, engaging content.

- Coordinate with the team to request additional project photos, videos, or information when needed.

- Submit completed photos and videos for review and approval before they are published.



Weekly deliverables:

2 edited short-form videos/reels.

2 edited photos for social media content.

Provide the finished content in the appropriate formats and sizes for each platform.



4. Community Engagement

- Find discussions where the company can provide helpful advice.

- Share useful information without overly promoting the business.

- Mention the company only when relevant and allowed by community guidelines.

- Monitor engagement and report relevant opportunities or inquiries.

Reporting & Communication

title: Youtube Creative Director - Hybrid/Remote
description:
We're Hiring: YouTube Creative Director (Hybrid / Remote)



Location: Davao City, Philippines (Hybrid) / Remote

Internal Team Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM PHT

Remote / CGE Schedule: Eastern Time (ET)



ABOUT THE ROLE



We're the team behind Shane Hummus, a leading career and finance YouTube channel. We also create content for established business owners, YouTube entrepreneurs, and business coaches.



We're looking for an experienced, creative, and results-driven YouTube Creative Director who understands what makes YouTube videos successful — from content strategy and storytelling to editing, packaging, and channel growth.



This is a hands-on creative role, not just a management position.



You'll work directly with Shane (CEO) and our production team to develop content ideas, create engaging videos, improve channel performance, and help grow multiple YouTube channels.



We're especially interested in candidates who have managed YouTube channels, developed content strategies, and successfully grown channels through their creative direction.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Long-Form Video Editing: Edit engaging talking-head, podcast, and interview videos with strong hooks, storytelling, pacing, B-roll, captions, and retention-focused editing.



YouTube Content Strategy: Develop content strategies aligned with each channel's audience, niche, and business objectives.



Content Planning & Ideation: Research trends, identify high-potential video topics, and plan content calendars.



Creative Direction: Oversee the creative process from ideation and scripting support to editing, thumbnails, and publishing.



YouTube Channel Growth: Identify opportunities to improve views, subscribers, audience retention, and engagement.



Thumbnail & Title Strategy: Collaborate on compelling titles, thumbnails, and video packaging designed to increase click-through rates.



Performance Analysis: Analyze YouTube metrics, including CTR, average view duration, audience retention, and conversions, to improve future content.



Creative Collaboration: Work directly with Shane, clients, and the production team to maintain content quality and consistency.



Additional Creative Projects: Occasionally turn content ideas into clear visual presentations using tools such as Miro and Google Slides.



NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



Proven long-form YouTube editing experience, particularly with talking-head, podcast, interview, or educational content.



Strong understanding of YouTube-native editing, including hooks, storytelling, pacing, B-roll, captions, and audience retention.



Advanced proficiency with professional editing software, preferably Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.



A portfolio featuring published YouTube videos, including links to the channels where your work was uploaded.



At least ONE of the following additional skills:



YouTube Thumbnail Design: Experience creating click-worthy thumbnails that improve video packaging and CTR.



YouTube Strategy: Experience with content planning, titles, SEO, analytics, video ideation, and channel growth.



Excellent English communication skills and confidence working directly with the CEO, clients, and production team.



Strong creative judgment combined with a data-driven mindset.



Ability to manage multiple creative projects, meet deadlines, and maintain consistent video quality.



For hybrid applicants: Must be based in Davao City and available to work with our studio team.



PRIORITY QUALIFICATIONS — HIGHLY PREFERRED



Applicants with proven YouTube channel management, content strategy, and channel growth experience will receive priority consideration.



We are especially interested in candidates who have:



YouTube Channel Management Experience: Hands-on experience managing YouTube channels, overseeing content production, and maintaining publishing schedules.



Content Strategy & Planning Expertise: Experience developing YouTube content roadmaps, researching video ideas, and executing content strategies designed for consistent growth.



Creative Director Experience: Previous experience working as a Creative Director or YouTube Content Strategist, leading creative decisions that contributed to channel growth.



Proven Channel Growth Results: A track record of improving views, subscribers, CTR, audience retention, or other measurable YouTube performance metrics.



YouTube Analytics Experience: Ability to interpret YouTube Studio data and turn performance insights into actionable creative decisions.



Candidates who can provide channel links, before-and-after performance results, and examples of YouTube channels they have helped grow will be prioritized during shortlisting.



BONUS POINTS



Background in digital marketing, branding, or viral content creation.



Experience working with YouTube creators, entrepreneurs, coaches, or business owners.



Strong understanding of YouTube SEO, monetization, and audience psychology.



Experience managing multiple YouTube channels or creative projects simultaneously.



Ability to identify emerging YouTube trends and adapt them to different audiences.



Experience using Miro, Google Slides, or similar creative planning tools.



WHAT WE OFFER



The following benefits apply to internal team members.



Year-end bonuses and performance-based incentives tied to content growth.



Health Benefits: HMO, dental, mental health, and telemedicine coverage after six months of tenure.



Paid Time Off: Paid week-long Christmas leave, PTO, and birthday gifts.



Trust-Based Work Culture: No time tracking or micromanagement.



Professional Development: Workshops, training, and opportunities to improve your skills.



Financial & Credit Support: Access to available employee financial support programs.



Real Creative Ownership: Your ideas and decisions will directly influence YouTube content strategy and channel performance.



Direct Collaboration: Work closely with Shane Hummus and an experienced creative production team.



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, please submit the following:



1. Updated Resume / CV



Include your relevant experience in video editing, YouTube channel management, content strategy, and creative direction.



2. YouTube Video Editing Portfolio



Provide 2–3 published long-form YouTube videos you personally edited.



For each video, include:



Published YouTube video link



Channel name



Your specific role and responsibilities



3. Thumbnail Design or YouTube Strategy Portfolio



Provide 2–3 relevant examples demonstrating at least one of the following:



YouTube thumbnails you designed



YouTube content strategies you developed



Titles, packaging, or content planning work



YouTube analytics or channel growth projects



4. YouTube Channel Growth Experience (Highly Preferred)



If you have previously managed or helped grow YouTube channels, please share:



Channel name and link



Your role in managing or growing the channel



Strategies you implemented



Measurable results, such as growth in views, subscribers, CTR, or audience retention



This information will help us prioritize candidates with demonstrated YouTube growth experience.



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Applying through OnlineJobs.ph?



Start your application message with the word "STORYTELLER" so we know you have carefully read the job description.



Applying via
?



Send your application and portfolio to:







 Subject: YouTube Creative Director (Story Teller) — [Your Full Name]



Important: Applications without published YouTube video links will not be shortlisted.



We're looking for someone who doesn't just edit videos — we're looking for someone who understands YouTube, knows how to develop winning content strategies, and can help turn great ideas into channels that grow.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to see your work.



Apply now and join Team Shane Hummus!

title: Accountant - Australia
description:
Evisory is a Brisbane-based accounting and advisory firm built for the hospitality industry. Our clients are cafés, restaurants, bars and venues – businesses where margins are tight and things move quickly if owners aren’t on top of their numbers.

We’re not a lodgement factory. We work in our clients’ files every day, keep their books current, and give them advice they can actually act on. We’d rather have fewer clients we know well than hundreds we barely talk to.



We’re looking for an Accountant to take ownership of a portfolio of hospitality clients, lead compliance across all entity types, and be the person clients trust when they need a straight answer. You’ll work closely with the Director, review the work of our bookkeeping and accounting team, and help shape how we deliver advisory as the firm grows.

▪ Prepare and review financial statements and income tax returns for individuals, companies, trusts and partnerships

▪ Manage your own client portfolio – be their main point of contact and keep work moving to deadline

▪ Deliver practical advisory: cash flow forecasts, budgets, wage and cost-of-goods analysis, restructures and business purchases

▪ Deal with the ATO on clients’ behalf, including payment plans, objections and queries

▪ Help onboard new clients and scope engagements with the Director

▪ CA or CPA qualified (or well progressed towards it)

▪ 5 years’ experience in an Australian practice

▪ Solid working knowledge of tax and compliance across all entity types

▪ Strong Xero skills plus experience with XPM, Dext, Deputy and FoundU

▪ Confidence talking to business owners in plain English and managing your own workload

▪ Experience reviewing others’ work and giving useful feedback

▪ Highly regarded: hospitality client experience, award interpretation, POS integrations, and a registered tax agent pathway



Answer these three questions to be considered:

1. What is your process on compiling EOFY Workpaper?

2. How many years of experience do you have in Australian taxation?

3. Do you also have experience in doing bookkeeping tasks?

title: UGC/Creator Manager
description:
## About the Role



We are looking for an organized, relationship-driven UGC Manager to lead our creator partnerships and user-generated content program. The ideal candidate has managed UGC creators in an agency or e-commerce environment and understands how to produce high-performing, conversion-focused content at scale.



You will oversee the complete creator workflow—from sourcing and outreach to briefing, negotiation, content delivery, and performance analysis. You will also play a key role in our TikTok Shop strategy, including affiliate creator recruitment, content coordination, product seeding, and campaign optimization.



## Key Responsibilities



- Develop and manage relationships with UGC creators, influencers, and TikTok Shop affiliates.

- Source, evaluate, recruit, and onboard creators who align with our brand, products, and target customers.

- Manage creator outreach, negotiations, contracts, product seeding, payments, timelines, and deliverables.

- Create clear, compelling briefs that communicate hooks, angles, scripts, calls to action, and brand guidelines.

- Maintain an organized content pipeline and ensure projects are delivered on time and meet quality standards.

- Review creator submissions and provide clear, constructive feedback and revision requests.

- Collaborate with paid media, creative, social, and e-commerce teams to identify content needs and winning concepts.

- Manage TikTok Shop creator and affiliate relationships, including outreach, sample requests, commission opportunities, and campaign participation.

- Monitor creator and content performance using metrics such as views, engagement, click-through rate, conversion rate, revenue, ROAS, and GMV.

- Identify winning creators, formats, hooks, and messaging, then use those insights to improve future campaigns.

- Maintain a searchable library of creator content, usage rights, agreements, and performance data.

- Stay current on UGC trends, TikTok Shop features, platform policies, creator strategies, and social-commerce best practices.



## Required Experience and Skills



- [2–4]+ years of experience managing UGC, influencer, or creator partnerships in an agency or e-commerce environment.

- Hands-on experience working with TikTok Shop, including its affiliate or creator ecosystem.

- Demonstrated experience managing multiple creator relationships and content projects simultaneously.

- Strong understanding of direct-response creative and content designed to drive e-commerce sales.

- Experience sourcing creators, conducting outreach, negotiating rates, and managing contracts and usage rights.

- Ability to write effective creator briefs, hooks, scripts, and content concepts.

- Strong project-management skills with close attention to deadlines and details.

- Confident communicator who can build positive, long-term creator relationships while maintaining accountability.

- Comfortable analyzing content and sales performance to make data-informed decisions.

- Familiarity with tools such as TikTok Shop Seller Center, creator-management platforms, project-management software, spreadsheets, and shared content libraries.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience managing TikTok Shop affiliate programs or performance-based creator campaigns.

- Experience with product seeding, gifting programs, and high-volume creator outreach.

- Familiarity with paid social advertising on TikTok and Meta.

- Experience working with consumer products in [beauty, wellness, fashion, food, fitness, or relevant category].

- Existing relationships with UGC creators, TikTok affiliates, or creator agencies.

- Experience scaling a creator program across multiple products, brands, or client accounts.



## What Success Looks Like



- A reliable pipeline of qualified creators and TikTok Shop affiliates.

- Consistent delivery of high-quality, on-brand content.

- Faster creator turnaround times and fewer missed deadlines.

title: SHOPIFY DROPSHIPPING EXPERT
description:
Shopify Dropshipping Specialist



We are a fast-growing e-commerce and marketing company that specializes in building, launching, and scaling profitable Shopify dropshipping stores for our clients. Our mission is to identify winning products, create high-converting storefronts, and drive scalable traffic through paid advertising and automated fulfillment systems.



We are seeking a Shopify Dropshipping Expert who can manage the full lifecycle of dropshipping stores—from product research and supplier sourcing to paid ads management and scaling performance.



Responsibilities

Product Research & Supplier Sourcing



Identify trending, high-demand products suitable for Shopify dropshipping.



Source and vet reliable suppliers (AliExpress, private agents, wholesalers, etc.).



Ensure competitive pricing, shipping times, and product quality standards.



Shopify Store Setup & Product Listings

Implement upsells, bundles, and conversion-focused layouts.



Manage product imports, variants, and inventory settings.

Test creatives, audiences, hooks, and offers to find winning combinations.



Scale profitable campaigns while maintaining target CPA/ROAS.



Monitor ad performance and adjust budgets and targeting accordingly.



Automation & Fulfillment Management



Implement and manage dropshipping apps and integrations (DSers, AutoDS, CJ, etc.).



Ensure seamless order routing, tracking updates, and supplier sync.

Optimize product pages, offers, and pricing to maximize conversion rate and AOV.



Test bundles, upsells, landing pages, and promotions.



Identify winning products and scale across stores.



Performance Monitoring & Reporting

Provide weekly reports and growth recommendations.



Monitor product performance and discontinue underperformers.



Collaboration



Work with creative teams to produce ad creatives and UGC-style content.



Align product and advertising strategy across campaigns and stores.



Support internal teams and clients with Shopify dropshipping best practices.



Requirements



Proven experience running Shopify dropshipping stores and paid ads.



Strong product research and supplier sourcing experience.



Experience managing Meta, TikTok, or Google e-commerce ad campaigns.



Familiarity with dropshipping tools (DSers, AutoDS, Zendrop, CJdropshipping, etc.).



Understanding of conversion optimization and funnel performance.



Ability to analyze store and ad metrics to scale winning products.



Strong organization and communication skills.

title: Back Office Medical Administrative Coordinator
description:
Canyon Pain Center is looking for a dependable, organized person to help keep our back-office work moving. This role includes prior authorizations, medical records, personal injury billing support, appointment scheduling, and follow-up on office projects.



We’re looking for someone who can manage several open tasks, keep accurate records, and follow through without needing constant reminders.



What you’ll do

Prior authorizations: Submit authorization requests, gather supporting documentation, track status, and follow up on pending requests or missing information.



Medical records: Request outside records, process incoming records, organize documents in patient charts, and help fulfill records requests according to office procedures.



Personal injury billing support: Prepare and send billing statements and supporting records to attorney offices or other appropriate contacts, track outstanding requests and balances, and document follow-up. This is not a traditional insurance billing or coding position.



Appointment scheduling: Schedule appointments and follow-ups, contact patients who need to be scheduled, and coordinate with the clinical team when needed.



Project coordination: Maintain task lists, track deadlines, follow up with staff or outside contacts, and help move office projects through completion.



General back-office support: Manage assigned inboxes, faxes, and work queues; communicate with patients, attorney offices, insurance plans, and other medical offices; and keep clear notes on completed work and next steps.



What we’re looking for

Experience in a medical office or a similar administrative role.



Strong organization, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.



Clear, professional communication by phone,
, and in writing.



Comfort using electronic health records, spreadsheets, and online portals.



Ability to prioritize work, track pending items, and ask questions when something is unclear.



Good judgment when handling confidential patient and financial information.



Experience with prior authorizations, medical records, personal injury cases, or attorney billing is a plus. You do not need to have done every part of this job, but you should be comfortable learning new processes and taking ownership of your assigned work.

title: Virtual Home Health Quality Assurance Coordinator
description:
Schedule: Monday - Friday, 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM PST (Tuesday–Saturday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM Philippine Time), with a 1 hour break

Employment: Full-Time, Long-Term Remote Position



A new and growing United States-based, Medicare-certified home health agency, operational for less than one year, is seeking an experienced, organized, and detail-oriented Virtual Home Health Quality Assurance Coordinator.



A clinical background is required for this position.



The ideal candidate will have experience reviewing clinical documentation for a United States-based home health agency and be familiar with the Medicare Conditions of Participation, home health regulatory requirements, and CHAP accreditation standards.



The selected candidate will support the agency’s Quality Assurance and compliance program by reviewing clinical records, identifying documentation deficiencies, monitoring required corrections, and helping ensure that patient records meet Medicare, regulatory, accreditation, and agency standards.



We are seeking a dependable professional who can communicate respectfully with clinicians, manage multiple priorities, and support the agency's commitment to quality patient care, regulatory compliance, and survey readiness.



Required Qualifications

•	Clinical background required.

•	Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

•	Excellent attention to detail, organization, follow-up, and time management.

•	Ability to identify inconsistencies in assessments, physician orders, plans of care, and clinical documentation.

•	Ability to address documentation concerns professionally and respectfully.

•	Strong multitasking skills and ability to manage competing priorities.

•	Proficiency with EMRs,
, spreadsheets, virtual meeting platforms, and document management systems.

•	Ability to work independently while remaining accountable to leadership.

•	Reliable computer, secure high-speed internet, quiet workspace, backup internet, and backup power source.

•	Full-time availability during California Pacific Time business hours.



Preferred Experience

•	Experience with a U.S.-based Medicare-certified home health agency.

•	Knowledge of Medicare Conditions of Participation and home health regulations.

•	Experience with CHAP accreditation standards and survey preparation.

•	Background in Quality Assurance, clinical documentation review, compliance, utilization review, case management, or chart auditing.

•	Familiarity with OASIS, physician orders, plans of care, face-to-face documentation, homebound status, and skilled-need requirements.

•	Experience reviewing nursing, therapy, and interdisciplinary clinical documentation.

•	Experience with pre-billing chart reviews and documentation correction tracking.

•	Knowledge of survey readiness, audit preparation, and performance improvement.

•	Experience with ADRs, Medicare audits, Synergy, and Joint Commission documentation.



Primary Responsibilities

•	Review home health records for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timely submission.

•	Review OASIS assessments, physician orders, plans of care, face-to-face documentation, medication profiles, assessments, and visit notes.

•	Validate documentation supporting skilled need, homebound status, diagnoses, ordered services, and the plan of care.

•	Identify missing, incomplete, conflicting, vague, late, or noncompliant documentation.

•	Ensure compliance with Medicare regulations, agency policies, and accreditation standards.

•	Communicate documentation corrections clearly and professionally.

•	Track outstanding corrections and follow through to completion.

•	Verify corrected documents are properly completed, dated, and signed.

•	Assist with pre-billing reviews, chart audits, compliance monitoring, quality reporting, and performance improvement activities.

•	Maintain QA logs, audit tools, correction trackers, and pending-documentation reports.

•	Support preparation for CHAP surveys, Medicare reviews, and regulatory audits.

•	Identify recurring documentation issues and recommend educational opportunities for clinicians.

•	Maintain HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality.

•	Participate in virtual meetings, training, quality initiatives, and workflow improvement efforts.



Applicants with strong clinical and home health backgrounds may be considered if they demonstrate the ability and willingness to learn Medicare and CHAP requirements.



Preferred Candidate

The ideal candidate will be:

•	Experienced in U.S. home health Quality Assurance.

•	Knowledgeable about Medicare home health documentation and compliance requirements.

•	Familiar with OASIS, plans of care, physician orders, and clinical documentation.

•	Experienced with ADRs, Medicare audits, Synergy, and Joint Commission documentation.

•	Able to provide clear, accurate, and respectful feedback.

•	Organized, dependable, and deadline-oriented.

•	Proactive in identifying and resolving documentation risks.

•	Comfortable communicating with clinicians, physicians, office staff, and leadership.

•	Interested in helping a growing agency build strong Quality Assurance processes.



Compensation and Benefits

•	Starting compensation: $10.00 USD per hour.

•	Three paid holidays annually, subject to approval and staffing coverage.

•	December bonus equivalent to one month of base compensation, subject to performance and company policy.

•	Paid vacation eligibility after one year of service.

•	Compensation review after one year based on performance, attendance, reliability, expanded responsibilities, and company financial performance.

•	Training and professional growth opportunities as the agency expands.



How to Apply

Please submit the following to 

•	Current résumé.

•	Brief summary of clinical background.

•	Summary of U.S. home health experience.

•	Experience with Quality Assurance, chart review, OASIS, clinical documentation, or regulatory compliance.

•	Experience with Medicare Conditions of Participation and/or accreditation standards.

•	List of home health EMR systems used.

•	Confirmation of availability during California Pacific Time business hours.

•	Information regarding computer, internet connection, backup internet, and backup power source.

•	Brief explanation of why you are a strong candidate for this position.



Qualified applicants may be invited to participate in a virtual interview and complete a brief Quality Assurance or clinical documentation assessment.



We are committed to building a professional, collaborative, and supportive team that values clinical accuracy, accountability, compliance, respectful communication, teamwork, and excellent patient care.



Compensation, benefits, work schedule, employment classification, bonus eligibility, and other terms will be confirmed in the final written agreement and administered in accordance with company policy and applicable requirements.
