title: Executive Assistant In Real Estate
description:
(Admin, Real Estate & Business Development) — Part-Time, Remote – Work from Home



The Opportunity

Are you the kind of EA who sees what needs doing before you're asked? Do you enjoy keeping a busy person organised and on track, and are you comfortable telling them, politely and directly, when something is slipping?



We're looking for a sharp, proactive Executive Assistant to support the Senior Agent and Business Manager of an Australian-based real estate agency and property development company in Queensland. As well as running the business, she is selling a large residential land estate, with around 300 blocks to sell over the next five to six years, alongside resales and upcoming house-and-land packages. You'll also help the wider real estate agency from time to time, including building out its rental database.



This is not a typical task-taker VA role. We need someone who thinks ahead, brings ideas to the table and takes ownership of the inbox, the diary and the sales pipeline, rather than waiting to be told what to do. You'll be a right hand, a sounding board and an accountability partner, starting at 20 hours per week with the potential to grow into a full-time role.



About the Role

This role covers two connected areas. The first is our Senior Agent's own sales work: responding to buyer enquiries on the land estate, keeping track of what's still for sale, managing the pipeline, re-engaging the database and handling the paperwork that comes with each sale. The second is supporting the real estate agency, including building out the rental database, prospecting for new sales and rental listings, and general real estate admin.



The split between the two will change from week to week, so you'll need to stay across both at all times. You'll report directly to our Senior Agent and Business Manager and occasionally pick up work for the wider agency team. Marketing is mostly handled by an external marketing company, so creative work will be limited to posting basic content from existing Canva templates when needed.



Just as important as the tasks is how you work. She wants someone who will manage her time, remind her of deadlines and action items, and hold her accountable in a polite, firm and respectful way. She values direct communication, fresh ideas and someone who will speak up with recommendations, and she wants help streamlining the way things are done so there's less double handling and the business feels far more manageable.





Key Responsibilities

Inbox, Calendar & Accountability

• Manage our Senior Agent's inbox: sort and prioritise
s, reply to routine enquiries and flag what needs her attention.

• Manage her calendar, including inspections, appointments and meetings, and protect time for sales activity.

• Track her tasks, deadlines, meetings and action items, and follow up on them in a direct but respectful way.

• Run regular check-ins on priorities, progress and anything overdue.

• Act as a sounding board, bring ideas and recommendations, and speak up when something could be done better.



Sales Support & Pipeline Management

• Respond to buyer enquiries about the estate, including which blocks are still available, block sizes, pricing and stages.

• Keep an accurate, up-to-date record of available, under contract and sold blocks.

• Manage the buyer pipeline in our CRM (AgentBox): log every enquiry, schedule follow-ups and make sure no lead goes cold.

• Follow up enquiries, inspections and contracts by
 and phone.

• Upload and update listings in the CRM and on the property portals.

• Prepare and lodge applications and documentation for property sales, tracking conditions and key dates through to settlement.



Database & Business Development

• Re-engage our existing database through regular newsletters,
s and follow-up campaigns to generate more sales.

• Find new potential buyers for the land estate and house-and-land packages.

• Use iD4me to identify property owners, build call lists and support prospecting for resale listings.

• Run just-sold and local area campaigns by phone, SMS and
, in line with Do Not Call Register and privacy requirements.

• Help build out the agency's rental database and identify landlords and investors who may need property management.

• Book appraisals and appointments for our Senior Agent.



Systems & Process Improvement

• Review how work currently gets done and find ways to remove double handling and manual data entry.

• Set up templates, checklists and, where it makes sense, simple automations to save time.

• Document key processes so they're consistent and repeatable.



Agency Support (as required)

• Provide general real estate admin support to the agency as requested.

• Post basic social media content using existing Canva templates when needed.

• Provide a brief weekly progress update.



About You

You're an experienced real estate PA who knows how an Australian agency runs. You're confident with CRMs and other software and pick up new systems quickly. You understand the sales process from enquiry through to settlement, and you know what good business development looks like in real estate. You're sharp, organised and have an eye for detail that means nothing slips through the cracks.



You're a genuine self-starter. You don't wait for a task list; you look at the pipeline, the diary and the database and work out what needs to happen next. You're comfortable speaking up, sharing suggestions and holding the person you support to their commitments, always with respect and never talking down. You enjoy finding better ways of doing things, whether that's a cleaner process, a smarter template or a simple automation.



You MUST have your own safe, private and distraction-free home office with a reliable computer, stable high-speed internet and stable power.



Experience & Skills

Essential

• Proven experience as a PA, EA or VA supporting an Australian real estate agent or agency.

• Experience using a CRM and other business software, with the ability to learn new systems quickly.

• Strong general admin skills, including inbox and calendar management for a busy agent.

• Strong pipeline management skills and a track record of following up leads.

• Real estate business development experience, such as database calling, appraisal booking and just-sold campaigns.

• A working understanding of the Australian property sales process, including applications, contracts and settlement.

• Confident speaking with Australian clients by phone and
, with excellent written and spoken English.

• Exceptional attention to detail.

• The ability to work independently, take initiative and manage your own priorities.



Highly Favourable

• Experience with AgentBox CRM (preferred).

• Experience using iD4me for owner lookups, prospecting and building call lists (preferred).

• Queensland real estate experience.

• Experience with land sales, residential estates or property development.

• Property management or rental admin experience, including building rental databases.

• Experience improving processes or setting up automations, CRM workflows or AI tools.

• Experience uploading listings to 
 and Domain.

• Experience with
 newsletter platforms and Canva.

• Knowledge of Do Not Call Register and Australian privacy requirements for prospecting.



Personal Attributes

• Sharp, with exceptional attention to detail

• A self-starter who takes initiative without waiting to be asked

• Direct, polite and confident communicator

• Comfortable holding someone accountable with respect and integrity

• Goal-oriented and highly organised

• A problem solver who enjoys streamlining processes

• Brings ideas, recommendations and suggestions to the table

• Reliable, honest and transparent

• Open to feedback and focused on results

• Looking for a long-term role



What's on Offer

• Part-time role: 20 hours per week to start.

• $10 AUD Per Hour (non-negotiable).

• Remote position, working from home on Australian Eastern Standard Time (Queensland) hours.

• The potential to grow into a full-time role (40 hours per week) as the business grows. This is not guaranteed.

• Work closely with an experienced Senior Agent and Business Manager on a large, long-term land estate project.

• Real input into how the business runs, with your ideas and suggestions welcomed.



How to Apply

Please submit:

1. Your resume and a short video with your own 1–2 minute elevator pitch based on the role.

2. A short summary of your experience with CRMs and other software (including AgentBox or iD4me, if you've used them), inbox and calendar management, pipeline management and business development in Australian real estate.

3. Brief answers to these two questions:

a. Tell us about a time you held the person you support accountable. What did you say, and how did it go?

b. Describe a process you improved or streamlined, and the difference it made.

Please ensure your answers are written by you and tailored to this role. Do NOT provide an AI generated response (we can tell).



Important note:

Please ONLY apply if you are looking for a long-term position and are comfortable with a role that blends admin, real estate sales support and business development. A lack of punctuality, integrity, professionalism or follow-through will not be tolerated. Please only apply if this role genuinely aligns with your CV and experience. If it feels like too much of a "stretch" for your skillset or experience, please do not apply.

title: Wedding Photo Editor / Culling
description:
Hello there,



Hope you are having an amazing day.



My wife and I are a husband and wife wedding photography team based in Canada. We photograph refined, emotionally weddings for couples who care deeply about storytelling and elevated aesthetics. We are currently growing and looking for a skilled wedding photo editor to join us long term.



We are not looking for someone who simply applies presets. We are looking for someone who understands light, skin tones, polish, and consistency. Our work leans clean, crisp, true to life, and high end. Attention to detail is everything for us.



You must have previous experience editing weddings and portraits. Strong proficiency in Lightroom and Photoshop is required. We need someone who can cull efficiently and intelligently from 6000 to 10000 images down to a powerful storytelling gallery of 600 to 1000 images. Retouching skills such as blemish removal, removing distractions, subtle dodge and burn, fabric cleanup, bra strap removal, smoothing wrinkles, and refining distractions are extremely important.



We are detail oriented and value consistency, communication, and growth. We want someone who is coachable, learns quickly, and does not repeat the same mistakes. We are easy going but hold a high standard for the final product.



This role will be structured monthly. Our busy season runs May through December and volume will vary each year. We are ideally looking for someone who wants to grow with us year after year and become part of our long term team. 



We are hoping to start with a $300 Canadian Dollar monthly pay for 8-9 months of the year. 



Please send your wedding portfolio for our review. We will NOT be responding to generic applications and applications without portfolio work.



Thank you so much for applying.

title: Affiliate Content Manager
description:
[IMPORTANT] To apply, please fill in the application form here: 



About Crafti



Crafti is a matcha brand selling in the USA and Singapore. We are a small and fast team that prioritises output and growth. We currently have over 5 remote Filipino team members and are proud to be a remote-first company.



The Role



We're looking for an Affiliate Content Manager to grow and run our network of affiliate creators: finding the right creators, getting them excited about Crafti, and making sure the content they post actually makes people buy.



This is an analytical role, not a creative one. You don't need years of experience. What matters is that you enjoy pulling videos apart to understand why some sell and others don't, and that you keep using what you learn to make the next round better.



You'll thrive here if you:



- Watch a TikTok or Reel and naturally break down why it worked or didn't: the hook, the first 3 seconds, the format, the comments

- Care more about whether a video sold the product than whether it looked nice

- Enjoy comparing results, spotting patterns and testing small changes to see what improves

- Can juggle dozens of creator conversations across DMs,
 and WhatsApp without letting anyone slip through the cracks

- Follow up and push things forward rather than wait to be told what's next

- Learn fast and pick up new tools (including AI) on your own



Do not apply if:



- You mainly see yourself as a creative and want to make your own content. This role is about analysing and improving content, not creating it.

- You don't use TikTok or Instagram regularly yourself

- You are uncomfortable being a project manager or following up with people who go quiet

- Your written English is not clear and professional. You will be writing to creators on our behalf.



What You'll Do



- Creator Sourcing: find and reach out to creators whose audience matches ours (women aged 25–35 who are into wellness, pilates and healthy routines)

- Affiliate Management: onboard creators, send free product, agree on terms and keep every creator moving from "interested" to "posted"

- Content Briefing: write clear briefs based on what has actually worked for us and what is trending right now

- Content Review: review creator content before it goes live and give specific feedback to improve it

- Performance Analysis: track how every post performs (views, clicks, sales), work out what the winners have in common, and feed that back into the next briefs

- Trend Watching: spot formats and trends we should test, and back up your suggestions with examples of how they are performing



What We Are Looking For



Skills:



- Strong understanding of short-form content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) and what makes people buy

- Organised: comfortable keeping trackers in Google Sheets or similar

- Clear, friendly written English

- Comfortable with tech tools and AI

- Bonus (not required): experience with influencer outreach, product gifting



Traits (these matter more than your CV):



- Urgency and ownership: today's task is today's responsibility and I get it done

- Proactive communicator: if something might go wrong, I flag it early

- Has opinions: I want to suggest a better way, and I back it up with evidence





Details



This is a remote contract role based in the Philippines.



Remuneration: PHP 75,000 per month



Commitment: Contract role with the option to extend if found to be suitable

Hours: Philippine business hours, Monday to Friday, 9:30am – 6:30pm, with flexibility to reply to creators outside these hours

ABOUT THE ROLE:



Alpha Technical Training is seeking a proactive, commercially minded Student Accounts & Collections Officer to manage outstanding student payments and maximise cash collection.



This is not a traditional payment reminder or administrative follow-up role.



We are looking for someone who knows how to have difficult financial conversations, negotiate payment arrangements, overcome objections and turn outstanding balances into successful collections.



Many of our students are working professionals completing trade qualifications. They may experience financial difficulties, competing priorities or delays in completing their payments.



Your responsibility is to understand their circumstances, identify practical solutions and negotiate mutually acceptable payment arrangements while maintaining positive student relationships.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



1. Payment Recovery & Negotiation

- Proactively contact students with outstanding course fees.

- Understand the actual reasons behind delayed payments.

- Negotiate realistic payment arrangements within company-approved guidelines.

- Offer structured instalment plans where appropriate.

- Secure specific payment commitments, including amounts and dates.

- Follow through on commitments until payments are received.

- Identify opportunities to recover overdue balances earlier without placing unreasonable pressure on students.



2. Objection Handling & Problem Solving

- Confidently handle objections such as:

“I can’t afford to pay right now.”

“I’ll pay next month.”

“I’m waiting for my salary.”

“I’m too busy.”

“I’ll get back to you.”

- Ask effective questions to understand the student’s financial circumstances.

- Explore alternative arrangements rather than accepting the first objection.

- Identify genuine financial hardship and escalate cases requiring special consideration.

- Know when to negotiate, when to follow up and when to escalate.



3. Student Relationship Management

- Build trust and maintain professional relationships with students.

- Explain outstanding balances, payment deadlines and agreed arrangements clearly.

- Help students understand the administrative and contractual implications of outstanding payments without making misleading statements or threats.

- Maintain a supportive but commercially focused communication style.

- Resolve payment-related concerns and disputes professionally.



4. CRM Management & Reporting

- Maintain accurate payment notes and follow-up records in 
.

- Record objections, payment commitments, agreed instalments and next actions.

- Monitor overdue balances and broken payment arrangements.

- Provide daily collection reports and weekly cashflow forecasts.

- Identify students with high recovery potential and prioritise accordingly.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS:



- Success in this role will be measured by:

- Total outstanding cash successfully collected.

- Percentage of overdue balances recovered.

- Payment commitments successfully converted into receipts.

- Number and value of realistic payment arrangements negotiated.

- Reduction in overdue account balances.

- Quality of student communication and compliance with collection procedures.

- We value actual collections and sustainable payment arrangements, not simply the number of calls made.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:



- Minimum 2 years’ experience in credit collection, accounts receivable, debt recovery or payment negotiation.

- Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confident conducting payment discussions over the phone.

- Ability to build rapport while maintaining a clear collection objective.

- Commercial mindset with strong problem-solving ability.

- Experience using CRM systems and maintaining accurate records.

- Ability to work independently and achieve collection targets.



HIGHLY DESIRABLE:



- Experience collecting education or training fees.

- Experience working with Australian customers.

- Experience negotiating instalment arrangements.

- Familiarity with 
 or similar CRM platforms.

About the role



BamBalm is a US lip balm brand with three scented balms: Focus (peppermint and rosemary), Energy (sweet orange and ginger), and Sleep (lavender and chamomile). We need a confident on-camera host to go live on our official TikTok account 5 days a week, show off the products, answer chat, and send viewers to 
.



You’ll be the face of the brand on our lives. We send you the products and a talking points sheet. You bring the energy and the personality.



What you’ll do



Go live on the official BamBalm TikTok account 5 days a week, 2-3 hours per stream, starting at 6pm EST (7am Philippine time)

Show the products on camera, talk through the three scents, and demo them

Keep energy up and keep chat engaged for the full stream

Answer viewer questions using the talking points sheet as your guide

Follow TikTok’s LIVE rules so the brand account stays in good standing

Send a short report after each stream (viewers, common questions, anything that went wrong)



Requirements



On-camera experience such as live streaming, live selling, hosting, or content creation

Fluent spoken English with a neutral or American accent that US viewers understand easily

Comfortable on camera for hours at a time with natural energy

Able to follow talking points and stay on message

Trustworthy with account access, and willing to use it only for scheduled streams

Quiet space, clean background, good lighting, HD camera, clear microphone

Stable internet (at least [25] Mbps) with a backup connection

Available 5 days a week at 6pm EST (7am Philippine time) without missing streams



Nice to have



Prior TikTok LIVE or live selling experience

Experience with beauty, skincare, or wellness products

Experience selling to a US audience



How to apply



Applications without a video will not be reviewed.



Record a short intro video, 30 to 60 seconds, with your face clearly visible and good lighting. Say your name, then one or two sentences about who you are. Speak naturally and don’t read from a script. Upload it to Google Drive or Loom and include the link.



Start your application message with the word “BALM” so we know you read this.



Answer these questions:



What live streaming or on-camera experience do you have? Include links to your accounts or past streams.



Have you hosted lives for a brand before? Which ones?



What’s your internet speed, and what’s your backup if it drops? Attach a speed test screenshot.



Can you commit to 6pm EST (7am Philippine time)? Which 5 days of the week?

title: Audio Editing, Mixing & Mastering Brief
description:
1. Overall track editing

 Remove or minimise loud breathing noises throughout the full recording.

 Remove unwanted background clicks, cracks, scratching and recording artefacts.

 Even out violin tone and volume where needed, while retaining warmth, dynamics and

expression.



 Mix and master for consistent, balanced playback on streaming platforms including Spotify

and Apple Music.



2. Specific editing notes

Time Edit required

0:21 Even out the start of the violin line.

1:00 Remove breath sound.

1:01 Even out violin tone at the end of the note.

1:41 Remove breath.

2:20 Remove breath.

2:39 Remove breath.

2:58 Remove plucking sound and breath.

4:04 Remove breath.

4:17 Remove cracking sound in background.

11:40 Remove crack sound.

12:29 Remove scratching background noise.

12:42 Fade out.

Please listen through the full recording for additional unwanted noises.

3. Four final versions

 Sublime – Extended Version: Full track; fade out at approximately 12:42.

 Sublime – Intro: 0:00–2:20. Remove the breath at the end and create a natural, musically

shaped ending with a gentle fade-out, not an abrupt cut.

 Sublime – Long Intro: 0:00–4:31; add a smooth, musical fade-out.

 Sublime – Middle Song: 7:40–10:21; add a smooth, musical fade-out.

4. Mixing and mastering

Master all four versions with consistent perceived loudness and tonal balance, appropriate for

digital distribution. Preserve the intimate, natural violin sound; avoid excessive compression or

artificial processing. Ensure edits, starts and fades are free from clicks and audible artefacts.



5. Deliverables

Supply four clearly labelled, mastered lossless WAV files (at an appropriate sample rate and bit

depth) and four high-quality MP3 reference files. All versions should be ready for digital music

distribution.

title: Senior Media Buyer
description:
Company Overview:

Truegenics Pte Ltd is a leading ecommerce company based in Singapore with a track record of over US$218M in online product sales. We specialise in e-retailing our own brand of health supplements to a global audience. We strive to create value and make a positive difference in the world, one life at a time. We believe that even the smallest action can define one’s destiny, and are committed to the creation of products that enhance the lives of our consumers.



Mission of the Role:

The mission of this role is to drive profitable e-commerce growth by executing and optimizing high-performing media buys across platforms, responsibly managing four-figure daily budgets to hit target ROAS while maintaining a great user experience (including weekend performance reviews). This role goes beyond adjusting budgets and switching ads on or off. You’ll help find customer angles, shape creative tests, and give specific feedback to our copywriting and creative teams. You’ll be accountable for the performance of your projects while working with the Media Buying Lead on priorities and broader strategy.



This role starts off as a 6-month contract role, with the possibility of conversion to a permanent position subject to individual performance and business needs.



Key Responsibilities:

- Own direct response projects on Meta. Plan, launch, manage, and scale campaigns for assigned products or offers, with clear targets for acquisition and profitability.

- Turn data into decisions. Monitor spend, revenue, ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, average order value, and other relevant funnel metrics. Diagnose performance changes and propose actions based on the evidence.

- Build a testing plan. Develop hypotheses, prioritise tests, define what success looks like, and use the results to d
 what to scale, revise, or stop.

- Find angles and guide creative development. Research customers, competitors, and market trends to identify fresh angles and hooks. Brief copywriters and designers, then give practical feedback on ad copy, images, and videos using performance data and your understanding of the audience.

- Manage budgets responsibly and optimise for ROI. Allocate spend across campaigns and tests, respond to performance changes, and scale what works while meeting profitability and return on investment (ROI) targets. 

- Work across the customer journey. Look beyond ad metrics to identify issues with landing pages, offers, checkout, tracking, or attribution, and work with the relevant teams to resolve them.

- Communicate clearly. Share concise performance updates, explain what you’ve learned, and recommend the next actions for each project.

- Maintain campaign quality. Follow Meta advertising policies, ensure ads provide a positive user experience, and review live campaigns regularly, including weekend performance checks when required. 

- Handle any other ad-hoc projects or tasks as assigned.



Key Requirements:

- Degree or higher (preferably in business/marketing or a related field) with 2 years of experience running marketing campaigns for e-commerce stores to generate revenue.

- Strong proven knowledge of media-buying platforms and its compliance/guidelines such as
, Bing, and Google Ads.

- At least 2 years and 1 year of hands-on experience managing
 Ads and Google Ads respectively.

- Analytical mindset and a self-starter with the ability to develop solutions and next steps for campaign testing.

- Positive and can-do attitude when handling new marketing campaigns that require rigorous testing.

- Sense of ownership in one’s performance and its impact on company’s success which includes responsibly managing a 4-figure media buying daily budget and achieving the target ROAS.

- Conversant in English and possess a creative mindset which will be useful for creating and writing advertising assets in the form of copy, video, and images that suit the target audience.

- Comfortable using AI tools to speed up research, explore customer angles, develop testing ideas, and analyse campaign results, while checking outputs against actual performance data and advertising guidelines. 



Key Technical Skills:

- Excellent understanding of
 Platforms

- Skills and experience with programs such as Canva and Photoshop are advantageous.

- Good understanding of media analytics tools such as Google Analytics UA & GA4.

- Familiarity with other tracking platforms such as Voluum, Hyros, Redtrack is a bonus.

-Experience with Microsoft Tools



Remote Working Setup

- A computer with suitable performance.

- At least two monitor screens, including the laptop screen.

- A noise-cancelling headset with microphone and a webcam.

- A designated workstation in a quiet, conducive environment.

- Reliable power and internet connectivity.



The Ideal Candidate

You’re a hands-on media buyer who enjoys the challenge of growing sales profitably. You’ve managed e-commerce campaigns on Meta, know how to make decisions when performance changes, and are comfortable being accountable for a four-figure daily budget. You can explain what the numbers are telling you, what you’ll test next, and when it makes sense to scale or pull back.



You bring more than platform expertise. You’re curious about customers, offers, and the reasons people buy. You can spot promising angles, brief copywriters and designers clearly, and use campaign results to make creative feedback more specific. When an ad performs poorly, you look across the full customer journey before d
 what needs to change.



You take ownership of your projects, communicate your thinking concisely, and stay attentive to live campaign performance, including weekend checks when needed.

title: Video Editor
description:
# Part-Time Video Editor — Short-Form UGC Ads (Remote)



We're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented **Video Editor** to join Mechanical Bookkeeping on a part-time basis, initially helping us produce short-form video advertisements for
, Instagram, and other social media platforms.



**You do not need to be an advanced video editor.** We're not looking for complicated motion graphics, cinematic editing, or fancy effects.



We need someone who can consistently produce clean, engaging, well-paced short-form ads from provided footage, scripts, and creative direction.



Above all, we're looking for someone with **exceptional English proficiency and attention to detail.**



**This is a part-time role today, with genuine potential to grow into a larger, long-term position as our business and content production expand.**



## What You'll Be Doing



- Editing short-form UGC (user-generated content) advertisements, typically 15–90 seconds.

- Cutting raw talking-head and UGC footage into engaging ads.

- Adding relevant B-roll footage to support the message.

- Creating accurate, easy-to-read subtitles and captions.

- Adding simple text overlays, zooms, transitions, and sound effects where appropriate.

- Removing unnecessary pauses, mistakes, and filler words.

- Following reference videos and existing winning ad formats.

- Producing different hooks, variations, and versions of existing ads.

- Exporting videos in the correct formats for Meta advertising.

- Organising project files and delivering finished videos on time.



## Our #1 Requirement: Exceptional English



**Your written English must be extremely strong. This is non-negotiable.**



We do not want to spend time correcting spelling mistakes, grammar errors, or inaccurate subtitles.



You must be able to:



- Understand spoken English clearly, including Australian accents.

- Write subtitles with correct spelling, punctuation, and grammar.

- Identify and correct errors made by automatic captioning software.

- Understand the context of what's being said so captions are accurate.

- Proofread your own work thoroughly before submitting.



**Every video must be checked by you before delivery.**



We expect finished videos to be accurate, polished, and ready to publish without needing basic English corrections.



## What We're Looking For



- Previous experience editing short-form social media videos or UGC ads.

- Extremely strong written and spoken English.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Experience with CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar editing software.

- Ability to create engaging, correctly timed subtitles.

- Understanding of pacing, hooks, and viewer retention in short-form content.

- Ability to follow instructions and match reference videos.

- Reliable communication and consistent turnaround times.

- Someone who can work independently and quality-check their own work.

title: EXPERIENCED COLD CALLER / APPOINTMENT SETTER — $4/HR — US CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY — STRONG ENGLISH REQUIRED
description:
15 Hours/Week | Monday–Friday | 3 Hours/Day | US Pacific Time | Long-Term Opportunity



READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING.



We are a US-based digital marketing and automation agency looking for an aggressive, highly confident, experienced outbound appointment setter to call American construction and home-service business owners.



This is NOT an entry-level VA position.



We need someone who knows how to take control of a phone conversation, get past objections, handle rejection, build rapport quickly, and BOOK QUALIFIED SALES APPOINTMENTS.



You will be calling construction contractors, roofers, remodelers, excavation companies, and other blue-collar business owners throughout Oregon.



These business owners are direct, busy, and often skeptical of sales calls. You must know how to talk to them naturally and confidently without getting intimidated.



If you are timid, passive, easily discouraged, or uncomfortable dealing with blunt American business owners, DO NOT APPLY.



THE ROLE



You will be responsible for outbound cold calling to book qualified appointments for our digital marketing, websites, and business automation services.



We provide:



An existing database of approximately 38,000 contractor prospects.



A defined service offering and sales approach.



An established CRM and appointment-booking system.



Scripts, talking points, and guidance.



A clear target market, and a clear offer.



A company owner who handles all sales demonstrations and closing.



You do NOT need to find leads, build websites, close sales, or invent our sales strategy.



Your job is to get the right decision-makers on the phone, create interest, handle objections, and BOOK APPOINTMENTS.



WHO WE WANT



We want a confident, sharp, persuasive cold caller with serious phone skills.



You should have:



Excellent spoken English, with clear pronunciation and strong conversational comprehension.



A confident, energetic, natural speaking voice.



Previous outbound B2B cold-calling experience.



Experience booking appointments with American business owners.



The ability to think quickly and respond naturally instead of reading a script word-for-word.



Strong objection-handling and rapport-building skills.



An assertive, competitive personality.



A thick skin and absolutely no fear of rejection.



The ability to make a high volume of calls without losing enthusiasm.



Experience working with a CRM and accurately recording call outcomes.



Reliable attendance and the ability to work independently.



Experience calling US contractors, home-service companies, construction businesses, or other small business owners is a major advantage.



Experience with GoHighLevel is also a plus.



WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY



Do not apply if:



Your spoken English is weak or you struggle to understand conversational American English.



You are uncomfortable speaking spontaneously.



You sound hesitant, timid, overly scripted, or unsure of yourself.



You take rejection personally or lose motivation after difficult calls.



You have only done customer support, chat support, data entry, or administrative VA work without outbound sales experience.



You need constant supervision or motivation.



You cannot confidently challenge an objection and keep a conversation moving.



You are looking for a position where you can quietly complete tasks without speaking to people.



We want a hunter, not an order-taker.



We are not looking for someone to simply read a script and hope somebody agrees to an appointment.



We want somebody who understands how to SELL THE APPOINTMENT.



PAY AND SCHEDULE



Starting pay: $4 USD/hour



15 hours per week.



3 hours per weekday, Monday through Friday.



US Pacific Time, preferably 9 AM–12 PM.



Approximately $60/week.



Long-term opportunity for the right person.



Performance will be reviewed based on call activity, qualified appointments, and appointment quality.



Opportunity for additional hours as the business grows.



HOW TO APPLY — REQUIRED



Generic applications will be ignored.



To be considered, provide ALL of the following:



1. A 60–90-second voice recording in English



Introduce yourself, explain your outbound cold-calling experience, and tell us why you believe you are an excellent appointment setter.



Do not read a prepared corporate-style introduction. Speak naturally.



2. Your cold-calling experience



Explain:



How many years you've been making outbound calls.



Which industries you've called.



Whether you've called American business owners.



Approximately how many calls you typically make per hour.



How many qualified appointments you have booked per week in previous roles.



3. Your approach to objections



A contractor answers your call and immediately says:



"I'm not interested. I've already got enough work."



Explain exactly how you would respond and continue the conversation.



4. Your availability



Confirm that you can work Monday through Friday, three hours per day, during US Pacific business hours.



5. Your equipment



Confirm you have a reliable computer, internet connection, and professional headset suitable for daily outbound calling.



FINAL WORD



We are building a serious, growing marketing agency serving American construction businesses.



We have the prospects, the offer, the system, and the sales process.



We need somebody who can get on the phone, confidently engage business owners, and consistently fill the calendar.



If you're an experienced cold caller who loves the challenge of turning a skeptical prospect into a booked appointment, we want to hear from you.



If you're shy, easily intimidated, or still learning how to hold a confident sales conversation, this is not the position for you.



Show us what you've got.

title: Product Manager
description:
We're a small, fast-moving software company building several AI-powered SaaS products across healthcare, business operations, and compliance.



We're looking for a sharp, entrepreneurial Product Manager who can help run product development across our portfolio.



You'll need to be comfortable wearing multiple hats: part product manager, part project manager, part business analyst, and part startup operator.



**What you'll work on**



We currently have four products at different stages of development:



* **Inflect** - AI-powered analysis of clinical communication, helping healthcare organizations evaluate and improve how clinicians communicate.  

* **ContractMani** - Contract intelligence software that helps businesses manage vendor agreements, catch billing errors, and avoid costly renewals.  

* **VisitAssist** - A consumer healthcare product that records and summarizes medical appointments to help patients and families understand their care.  

* **SDR Guard** - Compliance software that helps healthcare organizations identify documentation gaps, track regulatory deadlines, and reduce compliance risk.



You'll move between these products as priorities change. Some days you'll be working on a new feature; others you'll be untangling engineering tasks, investigating a customer problem, or figuring out why something isn't working as expected.



**Your responsibilities**



**1\. Product management and feature development**



* Turn high-level ideas, customer feedback, and business needs into clear, actionable product requirements.  

* Think through edge cases, user workflows, and implementation tradeoffs.  

* Identify opportunities to improve existing products, not just implement what's requested.



**2\. Engineering execution and project management**



* Own day-to-day engineering coordination and keep development moving.  

* Improve our development processes, documentation, and release discipline.  

* Make sure bugs, unfinished work, and technical debt don't disappear into a messy backlog.  

* Provide concise, useful updates on what's shipping, what's blocked, and what needs a decision.



**3\. Customer and business understanding**



* Develop a deep understanding of our products, customers, and the problems we're solving.  

* Think critically about usability, product adoption, and business value.  

* Proactively identify problems and opportunities rather than waiting for instructions.



**Who we're looking for**



**Must-haves:**



* Experience managing software products or coordinating software development teams.  

* Strong technical literacy. You don't need to be a developer, but you should understand how web applications, APIs, databases, and software development workflows fit together.  

* Comfort working with ambiguity, shifting priorities, and incomplete information.  

* A proactive, independent working style. You don't wait to be told what to do next.



**Strong advantages:**



* Background in software engineering, QA, business analysis, or technical product management.  

* Experience working directly with developers and reviewing their work.  

* Familiarity with agents and AI-assisted coding workflows.  

* Experience conducting user research or customer interviews.



**What makes someone successful in this role?**



We're not looking for someone who simply organizes meetings, updates tickets, and asks engineers for status reports.



We want someone who:



* **Takes ownership.** If something is unclear, you figure it out. If something is stuck, you investigate. If something is broken, you make sure it gets addressed.  

* **Thinks like a founder.** You care whether we're building the right thing, whether customers will use it, and whether we're spending engineering time wisely.  

* **Learns incredibly fast.** You can become conversant in an unfamiliar domain, ask intelligent questions, and identify what matters.  

* **Gets into the details.** You're willing to reproduce bugs, inspect workflows, write test cases, and dig into GitHub issues.  

* **Communicates clearly.** You can explain complicated problems simply, distinguish urgent issues from minor ones, and know when to escalate.  

* **Uses AI effectively.** You use modern AI tools to research, draft specifications, analyze problems, and work faster \- while applying your own judgment.



Most importantly, you should enjoy the variety and unpredictability of working on multiple early-stage products. We're particularly interested in candidates who have worked in small startups, owned projects end-to-end, or built something of their own.



**How to apply**



Please answer at least 2 of the following questions in your application:



1. **Tell me about a software product or feature you personally helped take from idea to launch.** What exactly did you own?  

2. **Imagine you're managing five developers working across three products.** Deadlines are slipping, GitHub has dozens of poorly organized issues, and the founder is busy with sales. What would you do in your first two weeks?  

3. **What's a complex industry or technical subject you had to learn quickly?** How did you approach it?  

4. **How are you currently using AI tools in your work?** Give a specific example.



Include Ayla PM - <your name> in the subject line

title: Amazon SEO Manager

ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

title: SEO Expert
description:
THIS IS A FULL TIME ROLE.



We are looking for a hands-on Technical SEO Developer who can implement SEO changes directly, not just recommend them. 



This role is for someone comfortable working inside CMS files, templates, and codebases to improve crawlability, performance, and keyword rankings. If your experience is mainly content SEO, reporting, or tool-based optimization, this role will not be a good fit.



What You Will Do

• Audit and implement technical SEO fixes related to:

• Crawlability and indexation

• Site architecture and internal linking

• Canonicalization and rendering issues

• Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile performance

• Work directly within:

• WordPress (themes, plugins, core files)

• Shopify (Liquid templates, SEO constraints, performance)

• PHP-based platforms (e.g. OpenCart or similar)

• Implement structured data and technical enhancements at code level

• Optimize websites for traditional search and AI-driven search experiences (GEO / GSEO)

• Take ownership of ranking performance and SEO KPIs

• Use SEO tools to diagnose issues, but rely on implementation, not automation alone

• 3+ years of hands-on technical SEO implementation

• Comfortable editing live websites and templates

• Working knowledge of:

• HTML, CSS, JavaScript (rendering understanding required)

• PHP and Shopify Liquid

• Experience working directly inside:

• WordPress, Shopify, and PHP-based e-commerce platforms

• Strong understanding of:

• Google Search Console

• Ahrefs / Semrush

• Screaming Frog, Lighthouse, GTmetrix

• Able to clearly explain why SEO actions are taken and how they affect rankings

• Good command of spoken and written English



Nice to Have

• Experience with SQL or Python / Node.js for SEO automation

• Practical exposure to Generative Engine Optimization (GEO / AI search)

• Proven examples of technical changes leading to ranking improvements



Important Notes

• This is not a strategy-only or reporting-only role

• Candidates who rely mainly on plugins, widgets, or third-party apps without understanding the underlying technical mechanics will not be suitable

• You must be comfortable implementing changes yourself

title: Part-Time B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter for Commercial Cleaning Company
description:
Clean Slate Elite Services is a commercial cleaning company serving Central Florida. We’re looking for a confident, reliable cold caller based in the Philippines to help us connect with local businesses and schedule cleaning walkthroughs.



Your main goal is to book qualified appointments for our owners to visit the property, understand its cleaning needs, and prepare a quote.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Call businesses such as offices, dealerships, gyms, salons, warehouses, and property management companies.

• Identify and speak with the person responsible for hiring cleaning services.

• Introduce our company professionally and ask about their cleaning needs.

• Schedule walkthroughs with interested decision-makers.

• Follow up with prospects who request another call or more information.

• Keep accurate records of calls, contacts, appointments, and next steps.

• Respect requests to stop calling and keep our contact records updated.

• Submit a brief daily activity report.



You will focus on starting conversations and booking appointments. Our owners will handle walkthroughs, pricing, proposals, and closing contracts.



REQUIREMENTS



• Clear spoken and written English.

• Previous experience cold calling U.S. businesses or setting B2B appointments.

• Confidence speaking with receptionists, managers, and business owners.

• Ability to handle objections politely and follow up consistently.

• Reliable internet, a computer, a quality headset, and a quiet workspace.

• Availability during agreed U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

• Experience using spreadsheets or a CRM to track leads.



Experience with commercial cleaning, janitorial services, or property management is a plus.



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



• Remote, part-time: 4 hours/day.

• Proposed schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time.

• Starting pay: $3 USD per hour.

• A short paid trial will be part of the selection process.

• Opportunity for additional hours as the business grows.



We will provide company information, sales talking points, training, and access to the agreed calling and lead-tracking tools.



WHAT COUNTS AS A QUALIFIED APPOINTMENT?



A confirmed walkthrough with a business in our service area where the decision-maker, or their authorized representative, has expressed interest in cleaning services and agreed to meet with our team.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A brief introduction and your relevant experience.

2. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and demonstrating how you would introduce a commercial cleaning company on a call.

3. The types of businesses you have called before.

4. Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time.

5. Your expected hourly rate and earliest start date.

6. Any past appointment-setting results, with enough context to explain them.



Please begin your application with “Clean Slate Caller.”



We value professional communication, honest reporting, consistent effort, and respectful treatment of prospects.

title: # Personal Assistant to the Founder — Remote | Long-Term Opportunity
description:
Mechanical Bookkeeping is a fast-growing Australian bookkeeping company helping trades and construction business owners take bookkeeping off their plates.



We're now looking for an exceptional **Personal Assistant to work directly with our founder and become a long-term, trusted member of the team.**



## This Is More Than Just Another VA Job



We're not looking for someone to hire for six months, delegate a few tasks to, and then replace.



**Our founder wants to find the right Personal Assistant once and build a working relationship that lasts for years.**



We're looking for someone who wants long-term stability, enjoys working closely with a business owner, and takes pride in becoming genuinely excellent at what they do.



As the business grows, we want you to grow alongside us — developing your skills, taking ownership of more responsibilities, and becoming someone the founder can truly rely on.



You'll have the opportunity to work directly with the person building the company, learn how a growing business operates, and have a meaningful impact on its success.



We value loyalty, trust, initiative, and consistency. In return, our goal is to provide a supportive, stable, and rewarding long-term working relationship.



## About the Role



Your main responsibility will be simple:



**Make the founder's life easier by taking ownership of administration, organisation, and recurring business tasks.**



You won't just be following instructions all day. We want someone who gets to know the business, learns how the founder works, anticipates what needs to happen next, and takes initiative without constantly being reminded.



Initially, you'll also help with some basic business operations and administration as our company continues growing.



**As we scale, we'll be bringing in dedicated operations staff to manage more complex operational responsibilities. Your primary role will remain supporting the founder.**



Our ideal outcome is that you become the founder's trusted right-hand person for many years, with a working relationship that becomes more effective as you learn how each other operates.



### Your Responsibilities (Initial Responsibilities — May Evolve)



**1.
 & Inbox Management**



- Monitor and organise business
s daily.

- Identify important messages, client requests, and follow-ups.

- Draft responses and reply to routine enquiries when authorised.

- Follow up on outstanding information.

- Keep the founder informed of anything requiring their attention.



**2. Client Onboarding & Administration**



- Coordinate administrative tasks for new client onboarding.

- Help clients provide required information and access to Xero.

- Follow up on outstanding documents and access requests.

- Keep onboarding checklists and client records updated.

- Coordinate with bookkeepers to ensure smooth handovers.



**3. Data Management & Reporting**



- Maintain and update internal Google Sheets trackers.

- Keep sales handover, onboarding, and client management records accurate.

- Compile regular operational updates.

- Identify overdue tasks, missing information, and bottlenecks.

- Ensure the founder has visibility over anything that needs attention.



**4. Basic SOPs & Administrative Systems**



- Turn Loom recordings into clear step-by-step procedures.

- Maintain and organise internal documentation.

- Identify opportunities to improve repetitive administrative tasks.

- Help simplify day-to-day administrative processes without overcomplicating them.



**5. General Founder Assistance**



- Schedule meetings and help manage calendars.

- Organise client gifts and administrative requests.

- Publish prepared social media content.

- Coordinate client testimonials and reviews.

- Provide additional business and personal administrative support as the working relationship develops.



## Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys being organised, helping others succeed, and making sure things run smoothly.



**The person matters more than the resume.**



You'll be a great fit if you are:



- **Extremely organised:** You naturally keep track of details, deadlines, and responsibilities.

- **Proactive:** You notice what needs to happen and take action without waiting to be told.

- **Reliable:** When you say something will get done, it gets done.

- **Detail-oriented:** You take pride in accuracy and doing things properly.

- **A strong communicator:** Your written and spoken English is excellent.

- **Resourceful:** You're comfortable figuring things out independently.

- **Trustworthy:** You understand the importance of confidentiality and handling sensitive information professionally.

- **Growth-minded:** You enjoy learning, improving, and taking on responsibility.

- **Long-term focused:** You're genuinely looking for a founder you can build a lasting working relationship with.



**Experience with the following is VERY advantageous:**



- Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Docs, Calendar).

- GoHighLevel.

- Xero or other bookkeeping software.

- Loom and SOP/documentation tools.

- Previous experience as a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant, or Virtual Assistant.



You do not need to be a bookkeeper or an operations manager. However, you must be willing to learn how our business operates.



## What Success Looks Like



- The founder no longer needs to constantly check
s or manually update data trackers.

- Client onboarding is organised and followed up consistently.

- Important messages and requests never get overlooked.

- Internal trackers stay accurate and up to date.

- Repetitive tasks become documented processes.

- You identify issues and help resolve them before they become bigger problems.

- You continuously find ways to remove administrative work from the founder's plate rather than create more.



Most importantly, **the founder knows that when something is handed to you, it's taken care of.**



## Why Join Us?



**1. Genuine Long-Term Career Opportunity**



We're looking to make a long-term hire, not fill a temporary position. Our goal is to build a stable working relationship that lasts for many years.



**2. Work Directly With the Founder**



You'll work closely with an ambitious entrepreneur who is actively building and scaling a business. You'll gain firsthand experience of how a growing company operates.



**3. A Role That Grows With You**



As the business grows, your responsibilities may evolve, and there will be opportunities to develop your skills and take on more responsibility.



We're not hiring you to eventually replace our operations team. We're hiring you to become an exceptional Personal Assistant who grows alongside the founder.



**4. Be Valued and Trusted**



We want someone who becomes a genuinely important part of the business, not just another employee completing tasks.



Our goal is to build a working relationship based on mutual trust, clear communication, and genuine appreciation for the work you do.



**5. Remote Working Environment**



Work remotely while being part of a growing, supportive team.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction and your relevant work experience.

2. The software and systems you've worked with.

3. An example of a process you've improved or an administrative problem you've solved.

4. A short Loom video (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself, explaining why you'd be a good fit, and what you're looking for in a long-term working relationship.



**One final thing:**



We're not looking for someone who's simply searching for their next job.



We're looking for someone who wants to find the right founder to work with, build trust over time, and become a valued part of something they're proud to help grow.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Creative Video Editor & Storyteller | Travel, Lifestyle & Fashion| YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook & Pinterest

About the Opportunity



I’m a US-based entrepreneur building a fashion brand while also growing my personal presence as a lifestyle content creator.



I’m looking for a talented, creative, and proactive individual who can help me develop, edit, organize, and elevate content across multiple social media platforms.



I’m not looking for someone who simply cuts clips and adds captions. I’m looking for someone who understands storytelling, creative direction, visual aesthetics, audience engagement, and social media growth.



Ideally, I want someone who can bring their own creative ideas to the table, offer suggestions, and help transform my vision into engaging content.



This position will support two distinct areas: my personal content creator journey and my growing fashion brand.



Key Responsibilities



1. Long-Form YouTube Video Editing



* Edit engaging YouTube videos, including travel vlogs, lifestyle content, storytimes, behind-the-scenes footage, and entrepreneurial content.

* Review and organize raw footage into cohesive videos with a clear beginning, middle, and end.

* Incorporate engaging transitions, music, sound effects, captions, graphics, and creative storytelling techniques.

* Improve pacing, flow, and audience retention.

* Help develop compelling intros and outros.

* Recommend creative editing approaches that enhance the viewing experience.



2. Short-Form Video Editing & Content Repurposing



* Edit videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and
 Reels.

* Repurpose long-form YouTube videos into engaging short-form content.

* Create platform-appropriate edits with attention-grabbing hooks.

* Incorporate captions, text overlays, sound effects, and engaging transitions.

* Identify opportunities to create multiple pieces of content from existing footage.

* Stay informed about relevant editing trends and content formats.



3. Creative Direction & Content Strategy



* Brainstorm creative content ideas for both my personal brand and fashion business.

* Suggest engaging hooks, video concepts, storytelling approaches, and content series.

* Help develop a consistent content strategy across platforms.

* Offer creative feedback and recommendations to improve content quality.

* Research relevant trends within lifestyle, travel, fashion, beauty, and entrepreneurship.

* Help identify ways to increase engagement, reach, and audience growth.



4. Social Media Content Support



* Assist with content planning and maintaining an organized content calendar.

* Help develop captions, hashtags, and platform-specific descriptions.

* Prepare content for posting across TikTok, Instagram,
, and YouTube.

* Assist with scheduling content when needed.

* Recommend appropriate posting formats and content distribution strategies.

* Review basic content performance and suggest improvements based on results.



5. YouTube Content Optimization



* Create visually appealing, clickable YouTube thumbnails.

* Suggest engaging YouTube titles and descriptions.

* Assist with basic YouTube SEO, keywords, and video organization.

* Help identify opportunities to turn YouTube content into additional short-form videos.



6. Pinterest Development & Management



* Help establish and organize my Pinterest presence.

* Create visually appealing Pins, including static graphics and video Pins.

* Assist with Pinterest boards, descriptions, and keyword optimization.

* Repurpose relevant lifestyle, travel, and fashion content for Pinterest.

* Help develop a Pinterest content strategy aligned with my personal brand and fashion business.



7. Fashion Brand Content & Creative Support



* Assist with content creation for my growing fashion brand.

* Edit behind-the-scenes footage, product development updates, and building-in-public content.

* Help develop engaging storytelling around the brand’s journey, vision, and products.

* Create promotional content and basic social media graphics.

* Understand and maintain the distinction between my personal content creator identity and my fashion brand.

* Offer creative suggestions that align with the brand’s visual identity and target audience.



Ideal Candidate



* Has a strong portfolio showcasing both long-form and short-form video editing.

* Has experience working with lifestyle creators, travel vloggers, fashion brands, beauty creators, or entrepreneurs.

* Understands storytelling, audience retention, pacing, and engaging editing styles.

* Is creative, proactive, detail-oriented, and organized.

* Can contribute original ideas instead of relying solely on instructions.

* Understands different social media platforms and how content should be adapted for each.

* Has strong communication skills and can meet deadlines.

* Is comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions.

* Is interested in developing a long-term creative working relationship.



Preferred Software & Skills



* CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar editing software.

* Canva, Photoshop, or similar graphic design tools.

* Familiarity with YouTube Studio, TikTok, Instagram,
, and Pinterest.

* Experience with content calendars and scheduling tools.

* Basic understanding of social media analytics and content optimization.



Initial Projects



I already have a collection of travel footage that I would like transformed into engaging long-form YouTube vlogs.



These videos will be the initial priority, allowing us to establish an editing style, creative workflow, and working relationship.



As we move forward, responsibilities will expand to include short-form video editing, content repurposing, Pinterest development, content planning, and creative support for my fashion brand.



The position will begin on a part-time, project-based basis, with the potential to develop into an ongoing monthly arrangement.



How to Apply



Please provide the following:

2. Relevant Experience: Examples of travel, lifestyle, beauty, fashion, or personal-brand content you’ve worked on.

, and Pinterest.

7. Availability: Include your weekly availability and typical turnaround time for both long-form and short-form videos.

8. Additional Skills: Let me know if you offer YouTube thumbnails, Pinterest management, content scheduling, or basic social media analytics.

I’m excited to connect with someone who is passionate about storytelling, creativity, and helping brands and creators grow!

This is not a “wait for instructions” role. You will be trusted to run your areas independently: d
 what needs to happen, follow through without reminders, catch problems before they cost the firm money, and keep the CEO informed. You will own outcomes, not just tasks.



How This Role Operates:

• If you see it, you own it. When something falls inside your areas, handle it. Don't wait to be asked or assigned.

• Manage your own work. Plan your week, set your own priorities, and track everything in Asana so the CEO can see status without asking.

• Close the loop. When a request is done, say so. When something will be late, say so before it's late.

• Bring solutions, not just problems. When you escalate, include what happened, your recommendation, and what you need from the CEO.

• Think one step ahead. Look for what's coming next (deadlines, client needs, gaps in a process) and act on it early.

• Be reachable and plan for coverage. Stay responsive in Slack throughout your shift. Request time off in advance and set up coverage so nothing stalls while you're away.



Decision Authority:

• Handle it on your own: Routine
s, scheduling and rescheduling, Asana updates, collections follow-ups, onboarding and offboarding steps, file organization, team recognition messages, and screening applicants against agreed criteria.

• Handle it, then inform the CEO: Fixes to billing or bookkeeping errors, updates to SOPs, and process improvements within your own areas.

• Bring a recommendation and get approval first: Anything that changes client pricing or fees, refunds or credits, client complaints or disputes, new tools or spending, hiring decisions, and commitments of the CEO's time outside normal scheduling.



Key Responsibilities



1. Support the CEO:

You own the CEO's inbox, calendar, and the firm's internal finances.

•
: Own the inbox. Fully handle routine messages, draft replies in the CEO's voice for anything that needs her judgment, and follow up on stalled threads.

• Calendar: Own the CEO's schedule. Book and adjust meetings in real time, protect focused work blocks, and step in on scheduling in WhatsApp and Slack without being tagged.

• Meeting support: Prepare agendas and background for the CEO's key meetings, capture notes and action items, and follow up until every action item is done.

• Firm billing & books: Own the firm's finances end to end. Invoice monthly fees on the 1st, subscription costs on or before the 20th, and completed projects within 1 business day. Run collections, categorize transactions, reconcile payments, update the cash position weekly, and close the firm's books by the 3rd business day for the CEO's final review.

• Subscription & pricing audit: Each month, check every pass-through cost the firm pays on behalf of clients against what clients are billed, and flag any price change the same day with a recommended fee adjustment.

• Weekly Summary Report: Submit a weekly report every Friday covering team KPIs, onboarding status, unpaid clients, project status, decisions you made, and where you need support.

• Taking more off the CEO's plate: Each month, identify at least one task the CEO is still doing that you could take over, and propose a plan to own it.



2. Support the Team:

You own the firm's systems, records, and people processes.

• Team support: Be the team's go-to for admin questions during your shift, respond quickly, and send reminders and prompts so deadlines and to-dos don't slip.

• KPI tracking: Track team task completion and KPIs, and have the data ready for every performance evaluation.

• Systems: Maintain Asana and Double alongside the Client Accounting Manager, and own firm-wide file management in Google Drive.

• HR administration: Keep performance review notes, and send birthday, holiday, and recognition messages.

• Hiring: Run the hiring pipeline when the firm is hiring, from screening applicants to scheduling interviews.

• Team onboarding & offboarding: Set up accounts, tool access, and permissions for new team members, and remove access the day someone leaves.

• SOPs: Create and maintain written and video SOPs for every process you own.



3. Support the Clients:

You own the client journey from first inquiry to kickoff, and from cancellation to close-out.

• Leads: Log every new lead in our CRM, notify the CEO, schedule a discovery call within 24 hours, and run lead nurture so no prospect goes cold.

• Onboarding: Send welcome
s and intake forms, chase missing information, and prepare an intake summary before every kickoff call.

• Offboarding: Send the final invoice, cancel any subscriptions billed through the firm, revoke access, and archive files.

• Communication: Acknowledge client inquiries within 1 business day, and keep contracts, intake forms, and welcome materials current.



Confidentiality

This role has access to the CEO's
, the firm's finances, client financial data, and team HR records. All of it must be handled with complete discretion.



Requirements

• Minimum 2 years of experience as a virtual administrative or executive assistant

• At least 6 months of hands-on QuickBooks Online Invoicing experience

• Experience managing an inbox and calendar for a business owner or executive

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive; comfortable making decisions without step-by-step direction

• Comfortable with Google Workspace, Asana, and Slack (CRM experience, especially Go High Level, is a plus)

• Experience at a bookkeeping or accounting firm is a plus

• Available 8am–4pm CST, Monday through Friday

• Reliable internet connection, backup power, and a quiet remote work setup



Success in This Role Looks Like...

• The CEO no longer has to remind, follow up, or check on your work.

• Her inbox shows only what needs her judgment, and her calendar runs itself.

• Billing goes out on time every month, and the firm's books close on schedule with minimal corrections.

• The team gets fast answers and timely reminders, and systems are always current.

• No lead or client falls through the cracks.



Compensation & Growth

• Starting rate: $3.00 USD/hour, full-time.

• Path to Executive Assistant: This role is designed to grow. After your first 90 days, the CEO will review your progress on autonomy, judgment, reliability, initiative, and communication. Once you are consistently operating as the CEO's right hand, the role moves to Executive Assistant, with a corresponding pay increase.



How to Apply

1. Reply to this job post with “RIGHT HAND” in the subject line.

2. In your response, state:

    ◦ how many years of administrative or executive assistant experience you have

    ◦ how familiar you are with QuickBooks Online invoicing

3. Tell us what makes you the best fit for this role.

***Applications that do NOT follow these instructions will be automatically disqualified without opening.

Set up attribution, pipeline, deal-stage, lead-source and conversion reporting.

Clean up properties, lifecycle stages, lists and data so reports are accurate.

Document each report: what it measures, how it’s built and who uses it.

Spot gaps in our data and recommend fixes.

Deliver a weekly or monthly summary of key numbers.

At least [2–3] years working in HubSpot, with real dashboards and custom reports you’ve built.

Strong knowledge of HubSpot reporting tools, properties, workflows and lists.

Able to explain data to non-technical people in clear written English.

Reliable internet and a quiet workspace. 

Bonus: HubSpot certifications, Google Sheets 



How to apply

Reply with:



Two or three screenshots or a short screen recording of HubSpot dashboards you’ve built. Hide any confidential data.

Your hourly rate and weekly availability.

Three sentences on the hardest HubSpot reporting problem you’ve solved.



Start your reply with the word “DASHBOARD” so I know you read the full post. Applicants who don’t will not be considered.



Paid test task (about 2 hours): Finalists get a sample HubSpot account and a short list of questions to answer in a dashboard. We pay for this time.
