title: Google Ads Specialist
description:
Trusted Digital is a growing Australian digital agency helping established businesses, particularly trade and service-based businesses, generate more leads, win better jobs and grow through digital marketing.



We specialise in Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, website development and digital marketing strategy.



We're looking for an experienced Google Ads Specialist to join our growing team. Someone who knows their way around Google Ads, understands what makes campaigns perform and takes pride in delivering results for clients.



We're not looking for someone who simply sets up campaigns and lets them run. We want someone who takes ownership, thinks strategically, looks for opportunities and understands how to turn advertising spend into genuine business opportunities.



The Role



You'll be responsible for managing and optimising Google Ads campaigns across a portfolio of Australian businesses, with a strong focus on local lead generation.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Building, setting up and managing Google Ads campaigns from the ground up.

- Managing and optimising Search, Performance Max and other relevant campaign types.

- Conducting keyword research and developing effective campaign structures.

- Writing compelling ad copy that attracts the right customers.

- Managing campaign budgets and bidding strategies.

- Monitoring search terms, identifying wasted spend and improving campaign efficiency.

- Setting up and monitoring conversion tracking to ensure accurate campaign data.

- Analysing campaign performance and identifying opportunities for improvement.

- Working with landing pages and providing recommendations to improve conversion rates.

- Preparing campaign reports and communicating performance insights.

- Identifying opportunities to improve lead quality, cost per lead and overall campaign performance.

- Working closely with the wider team to deliver results for clients.



Must-Have Experience & Skills



We're looking for someone who has:



- At least 2 years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns.

- Previous experience running campaigns for local businesses, particularly service-based businesses.

- Previous experience working within a digital marketing agency.

- Strong knowledge of Google Ads campaign structures, bidding strategies and optimisation.

- Experience with keyword research, search term analysis and negative keyword management.

- A solid understanding of conversion tracking, Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4.

- Experience managing campaign budgets and working towards lead generation targets.

- The ability to analyse data, identify problems and make informed decisions.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.



The Person We're Looking For



Technical ability is important, but attitude and accountability are just as important.



You'll ideally be someone who is:



- Hardworking: Takes pride in their work and isn't afraid to put in the effort.

- Reliable: Follows through on commitments, meets deadlines and takes ownership.

- A good communicator: Can communicate clearly with clients and team members.

- A problem solver: Doesn't just identify problems. Looks for solutions and takes initiative.

- Growth-minded: Always looking to learn, improve and develop professionally.

- Proactive: Doesn't need to be constantly chased or told what to do.

- Commercially minded: Understands that the goal isn't just to generate clicks or leads, but to help clients win more profitable work.



Why Join Trusted Digital?



We're building an agency with big ambitions, and we want people who want to grow with us.



You'll have the opportunity to:



- Manage campaigns for a growing portfolio of Australian businesses.

- Work across a variety of industries, with a strong focus on established trade businesses.

- Develop your skills across Google Ads and broader digital marketing.

- Work alongside an experienced team of digital marketing specialists.

- Take ownership of client campaigns and have a genuine impact on results.

- Take on more responsibility as the agency grows.

- Build a long-term career with opportunities for professional development and progression.

- Be part of a team where your contribution and ideas genuinely matter.

- Please include the words Cool Bananas at the top of your reply so we know you've read the full job description.



Who This Role Is For



This role would suit someone with at least 2 years of hands-on Google Ads experience, ideally within an agency environment, who is ready to take the next step in their career.



You should be comfortable managing campaigns independently, understanding performance data and making recommendations.



You don't need to know everything. But you do need to be switched on, willing to learn, take responsibility and have the drive to become better at what you do.



If you're looking to build your career with a growing Australian digital agency, we'd love to hear from you.



How to Apply



Send through your resume and a brief VIDEO introduction outlining:



- Your experience managing Google Ads campaigns.

- The types of businesses and industries you've worked with.

- Your approach to managing and optimising campaigns.

- Why you'd like to join Trusted Digital.



Look forward to chatting!

Your job is to make sure every profile gets good posts twice a week, every week. Our AI tools do most of the heavy lifting. We need a sharp person to pick the right photos, check every post, and make sure it goes live on time. Our clients look at their profiles, so a missed week gets noticed.

- Strong written English.

- You catch small mistakes, like the wrong logo or a city that doesn't match the profile. You care about the details.

title: Product Manager (Quality & Experience)
description:
The Role

We are looking for our first product manager who sweats the details. Our product spans a web app, a live voice agent, calendar and login connectors, and CRM and collaboration integrations. Your first job is to make sure all of it just works, and that the way it works makes sense to the people using it.



This is not a pure QA role. You will be the person who knows the product end to end, finds where it breaks or confuses people, turns that into clear and prioritized work for engineering, and runs the process that keeps product and engineering moving in the same direction. You will work closely with our CTO, our engineers, and our designer, and have a real voice in what we build next.



What You'll Do



Own product quality

- Test the full product end to end, including the web app, the voice agent, sign-in and calendar connectors, and third-party integrations, before and after every release.

- Write and maintain test plans, regression checklists, and acceptance criteria for new features.

- Reproduce, document, and prioritize bugs with clear steps, expected and actual results, and impact.

= Own the release sign-off process: d
 with engineering what is ready to ship, and what is not.

- Help build our automated test coverage over time (for example Cypress or Playwright tests for core flows).



Make the experience make sense

- Review flows across the product for clarity, consistency, and friction, and turn your findings into concrete feedback.

- Write simple, clear specs and user stories that our designer and engineers can act on.

- Partner with our designer, who owns wireframes and Figma designs, to make sure designs match how the product actually needs to work.

- Be the voice of the user in day-to-day product decisions.



Run the product process

- Run our planning cadence: gather input, prepare proposals and options, and drive prioritization discussions. Final calls sit with the CEO.

- Keep the backlog and roadmap in Plane organized, current, and the single source of truth.

- Make sure every decision ends with written next steps, clear owners, and dates, and follow through until they are done.

- Share product updates with the wider team so everyone knows what shipped, what's next, and why.

- Work daily with engineering on scope, tradeoffs, and timelines.



What We're Looking For

- 4+ years of experience in product management, product ownership, or a closely related role.

- Experience with B2B SaaS products.

- A strong QA instinct: you notice what's broken, inconsistent, or confusing, and you can explain it clearly.

- Experience writing specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from.

- Comfort testing products with many moving parts: integrations, connectors, permissions, and multiple user roles.

- Excellent written communication and an async-first working style. You write things down, follow up, and keep people aligned.

- Organized and process-minded: you can run a planning cycle and keep it on schedule without slowing the team down.

- Genuine interest in AI products and how people use them.

- Comfortable in an early-stage environment where priorities shift and you'll wear multiple hats.



Nice to Have

- Hands-on comfort with test automation (Cypress, Playwright, or similar), or willingness to learn with AI coding tools like Claude Code.

- Experience with Plane, Linear, ClickUp, or similar tools for roadmaps and backlogs.

- Familiarity with sales tools and workflows (CRMs such as Salesforce or HubSpot, calendar and meeting platforms).

- Interest in joining customer calls, running beta feedback sessions, or helping with onboarding.

- Experience with voice, conversational AI, or meeting products.

- Basic familiarity with Figma.

title: Executive Assistant to CEO & COO
description:
Executive Assistant to CEO & COO



Company: Free Life Wellness Center

Position: Executive Assistant to CEO & COO

Schedule: Full-Time, Monday–Friday

Hours: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Arizona Time

Location: Remote

Reports To: CEO

Supports: CEO/CFO and COO



About the Role



Free Life Wellness Center is looking for a highly organized, proactive, dependable Executive Assistant to support our CEO and COO and help keep the administrative side of our organization running smoothly.



This person will serve as a key administrative partner to leadership and a central point of organization for Free Life. Your primary responsibility is simple: keep leadership organized, communication moving, administrative systems maintained, and important tasks from falling through the cracks.



The position primarily supports our CEO, who also oversees the company's financial operations, while also providing administrative and project support to our COO in operations, HR, and compliance.



We are looking for someone who doesn't simply wait to be told what to do. We want someone who notices what needs to happen, keeps track of details, follows through, and gradually learns to anticipate the needs of leadership.



Key Responsibilities



Executive Support



-Manage the CEO's calendar, meetings, appointments, invitations, and scheduling.

-Monitor and organize the CEO's
 inbox.

-Draft and respond to routine
s on behalf of the CEO.

-Identify urgent matters and flag items requiring the CEO's direct attention or decision.

-Maintain a running list of items requiring CEO follow-up, approval, or decision.

-Prepare agendas, documents, reminders, and background information for meetings.

-Attend selected meetings, take notes, document action items, and coordinate follow-up.

-Follow up with leadership and team members regarding outstanding assignments.

-Help protect the CEO's time by determining what can be handled independently and what truly requires CEO involvement.

-Assist with administrative components of financial, vendor, contract, and business matters as directed by the CEO.



Shared Inbox & Communication Management



-Monitor the organization's Admin and Info
 inboxes throughout the business day.

-Respond to routine inquiries using approved responses and established procedures.

-Route clinical, HR, billing, referral, scheduling, compliance, and other inquiries to the appropriate team member.

-Flag urgent, sensitive, or executive-level matters for leadership.

-Follow up when
s have been forwarded to ensure requests are addressed.

-Maintain organized shared inboxes using folders, labels, archiving, and other systems.

-Identify recurring questions and help develop templates or processes to improve efficiency.



Administrative Systems & Organization



-Help organize and maintain Free Life's Google Drive and shared electronic files.

-Maintain clear folder structures, naming conventions, and document organization.

-Help ensure staff are accessing current versions of forms, templates, policies, and resources.

-Organize and maintain the company's internal intranet/resource center.

-Upload and organize policies, procedures, forms, training resources, leadership documents, and staff resources.

-Maintain company calendars, directories, contact lists, templates, trackers, and recurring administrative resources.

-Help create systems that make information easier for staff and leadership to locate.

-Periodically review administrative systems and identify items that need to be updated, reorganized, or archived.



COO, HR & Compliance Support



-Provide administrative support to the COO with operational, HR, and compliance projects.

-Coordinate meetings, trainings, onboarding activities, orientations, and leadership follow-ups.

-Assist with organizing HR and compliance documents and trackers.

-Track deadlines and outstanding administrative items.

-Send reminders and follow up with team members regarding requested information.

-Assist with audit and compliance preparation.

-Help maintain recurring operational and compliance calendars.

-Assist with onboarding and offboarding administrative tasks as assigned.

-Support the COO with maintaining organized records, documents, and internal resources.



Meetings & Follow-Through



-Coordinate internal and external meetings.

-Send calendar invitations, Zoom links, reminders, and meeting materials.

-Attend designated leadership or project meetings.

-Take clear meeting notes and identify decisions, assignments, owners, and deadlines.

-Send follow-up communication after meetings when needed.

-Maintain an action-item tracker and follow up with responsible team members.

-Bring unresolved or overdue matters back to the appropriate executive.



Special Projects & Marketing Support



-Assist with special projects for Free Life Wellness Center and affiliated business initiatives.

-Provide light administrative and marketing support for Free Life Fit as assigned.

-Assist with social media scheduling, marketing materials, event promotion, website updates, and content organization.

-Coordinate invitations, community events, promotional activities, and outreach projects.



Must-Haves

✅ Excellent English, written and spoken — you will communicate with employees, partners, and others on behalf of leadership.

✅ Extremely organized — you enjoy checklists, systems, calendars, and keeping information organized.

✅ Reliable — you show up on time, communicate, and do what you say you will do.

✅ Strong follow-through — you don't need to be repeatedly reminded about assignments.

✅ Good judgment — you can learn what needs executive attention and what can be handled independently.

✅ Tech-savvy — you can quickly learn new tools and systems, including Google Workspace, Zoom, and other business platforms.

✅ Professional and discreet — you understand that you may have access to confidential business, employee, financial, and healthcare-related information.

✅ Available 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Arizona Time, Monday–Friday.

✅ Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional workspace.



Nice to Have

🔹 Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Administrative Assistant.

🔹 Experience managing executive calendars or
 inboxes.

🔹 Experience managing shared organizational inboxes.

🔹 Experience organizing Google Drive or other cloud-based document systems.

🔹 Familiarity with project management tools.

🔹 Healthcare or behavioral health administrative experience.

🔹 Experience supporting executives or leadership teams.



Compensation & Benefits

Starting Rate: $6.00 USD/hour

Hours: 40 hours per week

Payment: Bi-weekly through our payroll provider

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Arizona Time

Breaks: 1-hour unpaid lunch and two 15-minute paid breaks

Sick Time: 40 hours per year

Paid Time Off: 40 hours during the first year

PTO Growth: Increases to 80 hours after two years of employment

Performance Reviews: Opportunities for compensation increases based on performance and growth within the position

Long-Term Growth: Opportunity to grow into increased executive and operational responsibility as the organization continues to expand.



What Success Looks Like



Within the first few months:



-The CEO's inbox and calendar are organized and manageable.

-The Admin and Info inboxes are consistently monitored and appropriately handled.

-Routine communications no longer require executive involvement.

-Leadership knows what requires their attention without having to sort through everything themselves.

-Meetings are organized and followed by clear action items.

-Follow-ups are completed without the CEO or COO having to constantly chase them.

-Google Drive and the company intranet are becoming organized, current, and easy to navigate.

-The COO receives consistent administrative support with operations, HR, and compliance.

-You understand what should go to the CEO, COO, or another team member.

-You begin anticipating needs instead of waiting for every assignment.



How to Apply



We want to keep the application process simple. We're more interested in seeing how you communicate, organize, think, and solve problems than receiving a long application.



Step 1: Record a Short Video — 2–3 Minutes



Upload an unlisted Youtube video or provide a Loom link.



In your video, tell us:



Who you are and where you're from.

Why you're interested in this Executive Assistant position.

What would make you a great EA/VA.

One thing you're exceptionally good at organizing.

What you believe makes an Executive Assistant valuable to a busy CEO.



Keep it professional but conversational. We want to see your personality and communication style.



Step 2: Answer These Questions in the body of the
 or an attached word doc

-How many years of experience do you have as an EA, VA, Administrative Assistant, or similar role? If none, that's okay — tell us about relevant experience.

-How would you rate your written and spoken English skills from 1–10?

-Tell us about a time you helped a busy person or team stay organized and on top of responsibilities.

-What tools have you used? Examples may include Google Workspace, Google Drive, Microsoft Office, Zoom, Slack, Asana, 
, Notion, Canva, or other business systems.

-Have you ever managed another person's
 inbox or calendar? If yes, briefly explain what you were responsible for.

-Are you available to consistently work Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Arizona Time?

-Rate your English (written and spoken) 1–10.



Step 3: Complete This Short Executive Assistant Exercise



Imagine you begin your workday and find the following:



The CEO has 32 unread
s.

An employee
ed the Admin inbox asking an HR question.

A community partner
ed the Info inbox requesting a meeting with the CEO.

The CEO has a meeting beginning in 30 minutes and needs a document for the meeting.

The COO asked you yesterday to follow up with three employees regarding overdue information.

Someone is requesting an urgent meeting with the CEO today but has not explained what the meeting is about.

You notice two meetings on the CEO's calendar overlap tomorrow.



Tell us how you would prioritize these items and what you would do first.



Then draft a short professional
 responding to the person requesting an urgent meeting with the CEO.



There isn't necessarily one perfect answer. We want to understand how you think, prioritize, communicate, and protect an executive's time.



Step 4: Send Your Application



Send your application to the
 address listed in this posting.



Subject Line: Executive Assistant Application – [Your Name] – Free Life



Include:



1. Link to your 2–3 minute video

2. Answers to the application questions

3. Your completed EA exercise

4. Your résumé in PDF format



Please follow the application instructions carefully. Attention to detail is an important part of this position.



What We're Looking for in Your Application



We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who:



✅ Follows instructions

✅ Communicates clearly and professionally

✅ Thinks logically

✅ Demonstrates good judgment

✅ Pays attention to details

✅ Takes initiative

✅ Understands how to prioritize

✅ Shows genuine interest in the position

Interview Process



1. Round 1: Application, video, and EA exercise review



2. Round 2: Scheduled Video interview with leadership



 3. Reference check



4.  Offer



Frequently Asked Questions



Is $6/hour really the starting rate?



Yes. The starting rate is $6 USD/hour for 40 hours per week. Performance and compensation will be reviewed as the employee grows in the position and demonstrates the ability to independently manage increased responsibilities.



Do I need previous Executive Assistant experience?



Experience is preferred but isn't the only thing we're considering. Someone who is exceptionally organized, reliable, professional, tech-savvy, and able to learn quickly may still be a strong candidate.



Will I attend meetings?



Yes. You may attend selected meetings with the CEO, COO, leadership team, or outside partners to take notes, track action items, and assist with follow-up.



Will I have access to confidential information?



Yes. This position may have access to confidential business, employee, financial, and healthcare-related information. Maintaining confidentiality and following company privacy and security requirements are essential responsibilities of the position.



Will I receive training?



Yes. You will receive training on Free Life's systems, workflows, communication expectations, and the types of matters that should be handled independently, routed to another department, or escalated to leadership.



What's the growth path?



As Free Life continues to grow, a high-performing Executive Assistant may have opportunities to take on increased executive support, project coordination, and operational responsibilities.



About Free Life Wellness Center



Free Life Wellness Center is a growing behavioral health organization serving children, adolescents, adults, and families.



Our leadership team values clear communication, reliability, initiative, professionalism, and people who take ownership of their responsibilities.



We're looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term opportunity and is excited to grow alongside the organization.



Ready to Apply?



Remember:



✅ Record your 2–3 minute video

✅ Answer the application questions

✅ Complete the Executive Assistant exercise

✅ Attach your résumé

✅ Follow the application instructions carefully



We're excited to learn more about you!

title: L2 Tech Support Engineer
description:
Dear Technology Lover!

We're a small (but VERY efficient) 20-year-old MSP based in Arizona.

As a small company. we're VERY employee-focused, and believe that our team members are our MOST IMPORTANT ASSET!



Here are some of the things you can expect from working with us:

• Ongoing (monthly) manager review and feedback- you should never guess where you are "standing" and what you, AND THE COMPANY, can do better!

• Paid certifications- we will pay for your courses and tests and allocate time during business hours to help you achieve your desired goals

• Paid Time Off- it's important to us that you are happy, healthy, and have a work-life balance!

• Bonuses- when the company wins, you win!

• Raises- As we grow, we believe you should as well. We have to stay competitive as an employer to retain our awesome employees!

• Opportunities to grow- In our industry, we can't be on "cruise control"... We need to push our team members to stay ahead of the technology curve. Help you continually sharpen your skills with a focus on your career aspirations.

• Paid sick days- We understand life happens. We don't want you to feel that you have to drag yourself to work sick if your body tells you to relax...



You're the right fit if you:

• LOVE learning, working with, and experimenting with new technology

• Get excited when you save someone's day and provide great service

• Are a hard-working, fun person, and see yourself being in the IT industry for the foreseeable future

• Want to work in a GROWING environment, with STABLE income, Bonuses, and a great attitude!

• Want the opportunity to advance and learn more!



Some of the responsibilities that your position will include are:

Helpdesk (mostly escalations, but some basic if needed), cyber security related tasks/ audits, cloud hosting and virtualization (HyperV, SonicWall, VPN), MS365 management and automation, BCDR (Axcient), networking (UniFi, SonicWall), IT projects, Servers maintenance (Windows only), scripts creation, testing new technology, and other tasks related to IT.



IMPORTANT:

This position requires AT LEAST 3 years of MSP experience and at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory, or lead role. 100% clean background check, highly organized, technologically savvy, and can work diligently with little supervision. Several hiring steps will take place to verify the above requirements, including reference checking, employment verification, technical testing, and more.



Minimum technical level that you will need to be able to pass a test on:

• Explaining to a non-technical person what the "cloud" is

• Consulting with a new client on what BCDR solution you would recommend to an SMB, and why

• Explaining what the differences are between traditional anti-virus and XDR

• Creating a new Virtual Machine on a Hyper-V host, from an ISO file located on a different computer on the network.

• Explaining the differences and commonalities between SharePoint and OneDrive.

• Creating an Intune policy that will install Firefox on an Azure-joined VM, and make Firefox the default browser, with the specific home page we'll provide to you during the test.

• Several other situational and technical questions.

• CCNA certificate candidates preferred but not required.



MORE DETAILS:

• A PRE-EMPLOYMENT BACKGROUND CHECK is performed (at our expense). You must have 100% clean background check. Please do not apply if you don't have 100% clean background check.

• Personality is KEY for us. We are looking for an easy-going, yet professional, friendly, and HONEST person.

• You will be working from home. This means you must have a quiet work environment and no excessive background noise.

• FAST AND RELIABLE INTERNET SERVICE IS REQUIRED with at least 100Mbps download speed and 20+ Mbps upload speed.

• As part of this position requirement, you must have a computer that will be used exclusively for your work with us. This means we will be installing our security software on that computer, will remove admin rights from you, and monitor/ control it for security and compliance reasons. In return, we will pay you additional “rent” fees, on top of your salary, in the amount of several hundred dollars. Details about this “rental” will be discussed during your second interview. There are minimum requirements that your computer must have in order to be employed with us. You must have a Computer/Laptop with at least i5 minimum 9th gen processor (preferably a newer one) with 16 GB RAM or more, or Ryzen 5/7 (MUST include TPM support) as well as Windows 11 OS.

• You must have recently worked on a night shift for 2 consecutive years or more.

• We evaluate/ review employees monthly and provide consistent feedback.

• We offer raises and bonuses according to performance, certifications, attitude, and customer reviews twice/ year.

• Your manager (our IT director) will create a roadmap for your "KPIs" and certifications track. We always push our team to earn certifications and additional knowledge – even allowing “disconnect study time” during business hours!

• On-call rotation (after-hours) for a week at a time, once every 4-5 weeks. It's VERY rare that we get calls after-hours (the average is only twice/ year!).

• We're closed on major US holidays, and at the completion of the first 3 months of employment, you'll qualify for paid holidays.

• Work hours are Mon-Fri at 8 am till 5:30 pm (UTC-07:00 , MST, Arizona time zone)

, text, and our booking portal) in clear, professional English

title: Senior SEO & AI Search Specialist | Australian Agency
description:
Help Australian businesses turn organic visibility into qualified enquiries.



Margin Media is an award-winning Australian growth agency working with service-based and B2B businesses.



We’re looking for an experienced SEO specialist to take ownership of strategy, delivery and reporting across an initial portfolio of seven client accounts.



This is a senior, hands-on role. You’ll investigate what is holding clients back, prioritise improvements, implement changes and explain the results clearly. You’ll work with our Australian team and a content writer to turn your recommendations into completed work.



We value sound judgement, accurate reporting and consistent follow-through.





WHAT YOU’LL OWN



SEO strategy and priorities

• Review each client’s website, search performance, competitors and commercial goals.

• Develop practical action plans focused on qualified traffic, enquiries and business outcomes.

• Identify opportunities across technical SEO, local search, service pages and existing content.

• Prioritise work according to its likely impact and the available time.



Hands-on implementation

• Diagnose crawling, indexing, site structure, internal linking and on-page issues.

• Implement routine improvements in WordPress or other client platforms.

• Prepare clear briefs for changes that require development support, and check the completed work.

• Assess backlink and authority-building opportunities for relevance and quality.

• Maintain clear records of changes, priorities and results.



Content direction

• Research search intent and the questions prospective customers need answered.

• Prepare useful briefs for our content writer.

• Review content for relevance, structure, accuracy and search intent before publication.

• Identify pages that should be refreshed, expanded or consolidated.



AI search and AEO

• Apply a practical understanding of AI search visibility alongside established SEO fundamentals.

• Recommend improvements and experiments supported by clear reasoning.

• Explain what can be measured, what remains uncertain and what the evidence supports.



Accurate monthly reporting

• Validate information from Google Search Console, GA4 and reporting tools.

• Check date ranges, comparisons, channel definitions and conversion data.

• Explain what changed, why it matters and what action should follow.

• Investigate unexpected changes and flag tracking or performance problems early.





WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• Substantial hands-on SEO experience, ideally 5+ years, including responsibility for multiple client accounts.

• Demonstrated results for service businesses, B2B companies or local businesses.

• Strong technical, on-page and local SEO knowledge.

• Confidence using Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, and a website crawling tool.

• Experience with Looker Studio and investigating reporting discrepancies.

• Working knowledge of WordPress and the ability to implement routine changes independently.

• Clear written and spoken English.

• Confidence explaining recommendations and results in a video meeting.

• Reliable communication, attention to detail and the ability to manage your own priorities.



Experience with Australian clients and collaboration with writers and developers would be valuable.





WORKING WITH MARGIN MEDIA



• Ongoing remote role, initially around 25 hours per week.

• Fixed rate of US$20 per hour.

• Agreed overlap with Brisbane business hours.

• Direct collaboration with our Australian team.

• Content-writing support, with you responsible for SEO direction and review.

• Workload and deadlines agreed against the available hours.



Your initial focus will be to understand the accounts, check the reliability of existing reporting and establish a prioritised plan for each client.





HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with:



1. A brief summary of your experience, including the number and types of client accounts you have managed.

2. Two examples of SEO work you personally delivered. Explain the starting problem, your actions, the timeframe and the results.

3. An anonymised report or reporting excerpt, with a short explanation of how you checked its accuracy.

4. One example of how you investigated an unexpected traffic or conversion change.

5. Your earliest start date, availability during Brisbane business hours, and confirmation that US$20 per hour for approximately 25 hours per week suits you.



Please remove confidential client information and share only material you are authorised to share.



Our hiring process is an introductory interview, a short paid practical assessment and a final discussion.



We’re looking for someone we can trust to make thoughtful decisions, deliver the work and give clients an accurate account of their progress.

title: Junior KDP Publishing Project Manager
description:

Manage book projects, deadlines and files

Research book topics, competitors and keywords

Coordinate writers/designers and review their work

Use AI tools including ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini

Proofread and quality-check manuscripts

Assist with Canva, book covers and A+ Content

Prepare and upload books to Amazon KDP

Maintain project trackers and follow SOPs

Identify errors and problems before publication

Help improve our publishing processes

Requirements

1+ years remote/project-management/content experience preferred

Excellent written English

Very strong attention to detail

Comfortable using AI tools and learning new software

Good organisational and communication skills

Able to work independently

Professional and comfortable receiving constructive feedback

Must learn from mistakes and avoid repeatedly making the same mistake

This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to develop into an increasingly independent publishing professional.

title: Event Designer
description:
About Innovate Marketing Group



Innovate Marketing Group is an experiential marketing and events agency creating meaningful brand experiences that bring people together. From corporate events and conferences to experiential activations, VIP experiences, and multi-city programs, our team manages the details that turn ideas into memorable experiences.



We believe great events come from great people, thoughtful planning, strong communication, and an obsession with delivering WOW service.

 

The Role



Innovate Marketing Group is seeking a creative, detail-oriented Event Designer to translate event concepts, client objectives, and brand identities into compelling visual experiences. 



This position will work closely with our account management and production teams to develop creative concepts, event layouts, visual presentations, branded environments, activations, stages, booths, signage, and other experiential elements. 



We are looking for someone who can balance creativity with real-world event execution. The ideal candidate understands that event design is not only about creating beautiful visuals - it also requires consideration of venue dimensions, budgets, materials, production capabilities, guest flow, brand guidelines, and client feedback. 



About You



You are a creative thinker who loves bringing ideas to life through thoughtful, visually compelling event design. You understand that great event design is not just about making something look beautiful—it is about creating an experience that supports the client’s goals, tells a story, and leaves a lasting impression on guests.



You thrive in a fast-paced event agency environment where multiple projects are moving at the same time, deadlines are tight, and creative direction can evolve quickly. You are comfortable shifting between projects, incorporating feedback, making revisions, and working within real-world timelines and budgets without losing sight of the creative vision.



You have a strong eye for design, scale, proportion, color, materials, branding, and spatial flow. When you receive a creative brief, you do not simply make something visually appealing. You think about how guests will enter the space, what they will see first, how they will move through the experience, where key brand moments should happen, and how every element works together.



You understand that event design also needs to be buildable and functional. A beautiful rendering is only successful if it can actually be produced. You consider venue restrictions, dimensions, fabrication methods, materials, installation requirements, guest capacity, accessibility, sightlines, traffic flow, and budget when developing your designs.



You are resourceful and solutions-oriented. If the initial creative direction is outside the budget, you do not simply remove elements—you think creatively about how to achieve a similar look and impact through different materials, finishes, rentals, layouts, or fabrication methods.



You are also a strong researcher. You look for inspiration, emerging event and design trends, materials, furniture, décor, fabrication techniques, experiential activations, and new ways brands are engaging their audiences. You know how to take inspiration and turn it into something original and appropriate for the client rather than simply recreating what has already been done.



You pay close attention to brand guidelines and understand how to translate a brand into a physical environment. You can take a client’s colors, typography, messaging, personality, and campaign creative and thoughtfully extend them across signage, stages, activations, décor, environmental graphics, and other event touchpoints while maintaining brand consistency.



You welcome feedback and understand that revisions are a normal part of the creative process. You do not become overly attached to one idea. You listen carefully to feedback from clients, Account Managers, vendors, and leadership, ask questions when something is unclear, and use that feedback to strengthen the design.



You are detail-oriented and take ownership of your work. Before submitting a deck, rendering, floor plan, or design file, you review it carefully for spelling, alignment, dimensions, branding, consistency, and overall presentation. You understand that even small mistakes can impact client confidence or create larger production issues later.



You are proactive about communication and follow-through. If you are missing dimensions, brand assets, venue information, or other details needed to complete your work, you ask for them early rather than waiting until the deadline. If you identify a potential production challenge, you flag it and help find a solution.



Most importantly, you genuinely enjoy transforming ideas into experiences. When you are doing your job well, the team can confidently present creative concepts that excite clients, differentiate IMG, can realistically be produced, and ultimately create memorable experiences for the people attending them.



Key Responsibilities 



Event Concept & Creative Development 

• Develop creative concepts and visual directions for corporate events, experiential activations, conferences, pop-ups, exhibits, and branded experiences. 

• Translate client briefs, objectives, and brand guidelines into cohesive event environments. 

• Create mood boards, inspiration boards, color palettes, and overall design directions. 

• Brainstorm creative event elements, installations, photo moments, stages, signage, displays, and guest experiences. 



Event Renderings & Layouts 



• Develop event renderings, floor plans, layouts, elevations, and visual mockups. 

• Create realistic representations of event spaces to help clients visualize proposed concepts. 

• Design stages, booths, registration areas, lounges, product displays, branded environments, and other event elements. 

• Revise designs efficiently based on client and internal team feedback. 



Presentation & Proposal Support 



• Create polished visual materials for client presentations, proposals, pitches, and RFP responses. 

• Work with the account team to ensure creative concepts align with the project's objectives, budget, venue, and production requirements. 

• Help communicate design concepts clearly through presentations and supporting visuals. 

Production Collaboration 

• Prepare artwork, specifications, dimensions, and other design information needed by production partners. 

• Collaborate with fabricators, printers, rental companies, and other vendors to ensure designs can be realistically produced. 

• Review proofs and production materials for visual accuracy. 

• Make design adjustments when required by venue, budget, timeline, or fabrication constraints. 



What Success Looks Like



• Creative concepts are visually compelling, thoughtful, and aligned with the client’s brand, objectives, audience, and overall event strategy.

• Account Managers can confidently present your creative work to clients with minimal revisions or cleanup. 

• Initial concepts and design drafts are delivered on time and allow enough time for internal review before client deadlines. 

• Renderings, floor plans, mood boards, and presentation decks clearly communicate the creative vision and help clients understand how the experience will come to life. 

• Designs are not only beautiful but also realistic, functional, and buildable within the approved budget, venue restrictions, timeline, and production requirements. 

• Client brand guidelines are consistently and accurately reflected across event environments, signage, stages, activations, décor, and other visual touchpoints. 

• Design files are organized, clearly labeled, current, and easy for the internal team and production partners to locate and understand. 

• Revisions are completed accurately and efficiently, with feedback incorporated thoroughly rather than requiring the same corrections multiple times. 

• Vendor and fabrication partners receive clear creative direction, dimensions, specifications, reference materials, and production-ready information when required. 

• Potential design, fabrication, spatial, budget, or production challenges are identified and communicated early. 

• You proactively provide creative solutions and alternatives when an original idea is not feasible due to budget, venue, timeline, or production limitations. 

• Your work consistently demonstrates strong attention to detail, including spelling, alignment, scale, dimensions, branding, finishes, materials, and overall presentation. 

• Account Managers trust that when a creative assignment is given to you, you will take ownership of it, communicate proactively, meet the deadline, and follow it through to completion. 

• Your creative work helps IMG deliver memorable experiences, strengthen client relationships, and win new business.



Qualifications



• 2+ years of professional experience in event design, experiential design, environmental design, spatial design, production design, or a related creative field required; 3–4 years strongly preferred.

• Prior experience designing for live events, experiential marketing activations, conferences, corporate events, brand experiences, trade shows, pop-ups, or similar environments strongly preferred.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating event, experiential, spatial, environmental, or related design work.

• Strong understanding of design fundamentals, including composition, color, typography, scale, proportion, hierarchy, materials, and spatial flow.

• Ability to translate a creative brief, client objective, or initial idea into a cohesive visual concept and physical experience.

• Ability to interpret floor plans, venue dimensions, measurements, and spatial requirements.

• Understanding of real-world event production considerations, including fabrication, rentals, materials, installation, venue restrictions, guest flow, sightlines, accessibility, and budget.

• Experience creating event renderings, floor plans, elevations, mood boards, presentation decks, environmental graphics, and other visual materials used to communicate creative concepts.

• Proficiency in relevant professional design and rendering software, such as Adobe Creative Suite, SketchUp, AutoCAD, Vectorworks, or comparable programs.

• Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and/or InDesign preferred.

• Experience with 3D modeling and rendering software strongly preferred.

• Proficiency with Canva preferred.

• Experience preparing or organizing production-ready artwork and files for printers, fabricators, signage vendors, and other production partners is a plus.

• Strong visual research skills and the ability to identify relevant trends, materials, furnishings, décor, fabrication techniques, and experiential inspiration.

• Strong understanding of branding and the ability to translate brand guidelines into physical environments and experiences.

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to reviewing work carefully before internal or client presentation.

• Comfortable receiving creative direction and feedback and making multiple rounds of revisions when necessary.

• Thrives in a fast-paced agency environment with changing priorities, tight deadlines, and multiple projects moving simultaneously.

• Strong organizational, time-management, and communication skills.

• Comfortable collaborating closely with Account Managers, production partners, vendors, fabricators, and other members of the creative team.

• Resourceful and solutions-oriented, with the ability to develop creative alternatives when budget, timing, venue, or production limitations affect the original concept.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment while staying highly communicative, responsive, and accountable.

• Comfortable learning and using project management, file-sharing, event, and agency technology platforms.

Our Core Values

WOW SERVICE: We are committed to great operations. Being accountable, a trusted advisor, and results oriented.

PROACTIVE: We are proactive to take the initiative to go above and beyond our job responsibilities. We are self-motivated and seek opportunities to make a positive impact.

FUN + ENGAGEMENT: We create a positive work environment that fosters associate and client satisfaction, engagement, creativity and productivity.

GROWTH: For IMG to grow, we must each learn and grow. We are humble and open to new ideas as our world is constantly growing.

INNOVATION: We are committed to a culture of innovation, forward thinking and adaptability, which can contribute to long-term success and growth.

COMMUNITY: We give our time and resources to support each other and our communities.

title: 3D Product Designer & Rendering Artist
description:
# 3D Product Designer & Rendering Artist



**Industry:** Beauty & Cosmetics  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Employment Type:** Full-Time Contract  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–5:30 PM Pacific Time (U.S.)



### About the Role



We are a growing U.S.-based cosmetics company seeking a creative and detail-oriented 3D Product Designer & Rendering Artist to join our team remotely from the Philippines.



This role combines product development, technical design, and high-quality visual content creation. The ideal candidate can transform initial product ideas into detailed 3D concepts while also producing photorealistic renders, lifestyle imagery, and animations for e-commerce, social media, and marketing campaigns.



**Candidates must be available to work during our U.S. business hours, Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM–5:30 PM Pacific Time. This is a required schedule, not flexible hours.**



### Key Responsibilities



- **Product Development:** Transform initial ideas, sketches, and references into creative 3D product concepts, including packaging, cosmetic products, and beauty equipment.

- **Technical & Functional Design:** Create detailed 3D models illustrating product components, functionality, assembly, and design specifications for manufacturing reference.

- **Photorealistic Rendering:** Produce realistic, high-quality renders of existing and upcoming products with accurate materials, colors, textures, and branding.

- **Lifestyle & Marketing Content:** Develop product lifestyle scenes and promotional imagery for websites, social media, advertisements, and product launches.

- **3D Animation & Video:** Create engaging product animations, motion graphics, and video content highlighting product features and functionality.

- **Creative Collaboration:** Work closely with U.S.-based product development and marketing teams, contributing original ideas, recommendations, and creative solutions.



### Qualifications



- Proven experience in 3D product modeling, rendering, and animation.

- Proficiency in Blender, Cinema 4D, KeyShot, SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or similar software.

- Strong understanding of lighting, materials, textures, composition, and photorealistic visualization.

- Ability to interpret product sketches, dimensions, and technical references.

- Experience developing functional product concepts and manufacturing-oriented designs.

- Ability to independently research, conceptualize, and recommend creative directions.

- Experience with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, or Premiere Pro is a plus.

- Experience in cosmetics, beauty products, packaging, or consumer product design is preferred.

- Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

- Reliable internet connection and ability to participate in virtual meetings during U.S. business hours.



### What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who combines strong technical skills with creativity and initiative. The right candidate can take a project from concept to completion, contribute original ideas, solve design challenges, and deliver professional, brand-consistent visuals with minimal supervision.



### Schedule & Work Requirements



- **Location:** Remote, Philippines

- **Work Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–5:30 PM Pacific Time (PST/PDT)

- **Availability:** Full overlap with our U.S. team's working hours is mandatory.

- **Work Arrangement:** Independent contractor

- Must be comfortable working overnight hours in the Philippines due to the time difference.

title: Creative Marketing Assistant — Luxury Brand Video & Social Media
description:
The Royal Cup | Remote, Part-Time | Seasonal-to-Long-Term Opportunity



**IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING | APPLICATIONS WITHOUT REQUESTED INFORMATION WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED **



Applicants **must already have access to professional, fully functional video-editing and graphic-design software**, such as CapCut Pro, Canva Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve Studio, or equivalent professional tools capable of producing high-quality cinematic content.



**The Royal Cup will not provide, purchase, reimburse, or subsidize editing software or premium subscriptions for this position.** Applicants must be able to perform the required work using tools they already have access to, subject to the applicable terms of those tools.



This position is **5 hours per week at $5 USD per hour ($25 per week)**. Please do not apply if these hours, compensation, software requirements, or creative standards do not align with your expectations.



## About The Royal Cup



The Royal Cup is a luxury private bartending experience specializing in elegant, memorable celebrations and elevated hospitality.



Our visual identity emphasizes royalty, refinement, glamour, cinematic storytelling, polished gold accents, and premium guest experiences.



We're seeking a technically skilled, creative marketing professional who can translate event footage into sophisticated, visually compelling content that strengthens our brand, grows our audience, and supports client bookings.



Responsibilities



- Edit premium short-form videos and Instagram Reels using existing event footage.

- Develop engaging visual stories with purposeful pacing, strong opening hooks, refined transitions, speed ramping, and synchronized audio.

- Apply sophisticated typography, color correction, tasteful visual effects, and consistent branding.

- Create supporting social media graphics, captions, and content concepts when assigned.

- Follow The Royal Cup's approved logo system, brand guidelines, and creative direction without altering established brand assets.

- Maintain organized, editable project files and upload completed deliverables to company-designated folders.

- Communicate progress during scheduled work hours, document time accurately, and submit content for approval before publication.

- Incorporate feedback constructively and demonstrate measurable improvement throughout training.



## Required Qualifications



- Demonstrable experience producing polished, cinematic short-form videos.

- Strong proficiency in at least one professional editing platform with access to all features necessary for the work.

- Ability to create original compositions rather than relying exclusively on prebuilt templates.

- Understanding of storytelling, pacing, audio synchronization, speed ramping, typography, transitions, and visual consistency.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and software access.

- Ability to work independently, manage creative production time, and communicate realistic deadlines.

- Willingness to follow detailed brand standards and maintain confidentiality.



Experience with luxury hospitality, events, weddings, lifestyle, or premium brands is preferred.



## Schedule and Compensation



- **Rate:** $5 USD per hour.

- **Schedule:** 5 paid hours per week, with an agreed schedule established before starting.

- **Work arrangement:** Remote, part-time.

- **Initial engagement:** Seasonal, through January 1, 2027, with potential for continued engagement.

- **Additional hours:** Not guaranteed; may be considered based on demonstrated performance, business demand, and available budget.

- **Overtime:** Requires prior written authorization.



Because advanced video production requires uninterrupted concentration, the five weekly hours may be organized into agreed longer work blocks rather than automatically requiring one-hour daily shifts.



Three-Week Evaluation Structure



**Weeks 1–2: Paid Training and Creative Calibration**



These weeks focus on learning The Royal Cup's visual identity, reviewing examples, practicing editing techniques, and responding to structured feedback.



The emphasis is on skill alignment and improvement—not immediately achieving full production targets.



**Week 3: Paid Final Performance Evaluation**



Candidates will be assigned a clearly defined creative deliverable with an agreed scope, deadline, and evaluation rubric.



We expect substantially stronger alignment with our standards, efficient execution, and minimal revisions for previously established requirements.



The results of this evaluation will determine whether we offer continued engagement, alongside reliability, communication, professionalism, and adherence to brand standards.



Recruitment Process



Qualified applicants may be invited to complete a **paid practical assessment** using provided creative materials.



Selected applicants will also attend a structured interview in which they must explain, in their own words, the position's responsibilities, technical requirements, expected deliverables, work schedule, and evaluation process.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your current professional video-editing and design software, including which paid or premium features you have access to.

2. Two or three examples of cinematic Reels or short-form videos you've personally edited.

3. A description of your editing process, including pacing, speed ramping, typography, transitions, audio, and color correction.

4. Your estimated production time for a polished 20–30-second Reel using supplied footage.

5. Confirmation that you accept the **$5/hour, five-hour-per-week** arrangement and the three-week paid evaluation process.

6. Your availability and preferred work schedule.



**Applications without relevant video examples or confirmation of the software requirements may not be considered.**



The Royal Cup values integrity, accountability, creativity, professionalism, and a genuine commitment to excellence.



We look forward to meeting talented professionals who share our vision.



The Royal

title: AU Senior Accountant / Tax Reviewer & Team Leader
description:
Capita Business Advisors and Tax Consultants is an established Australian accounting, taxation and business advisory practice expanding our Philippines-based team.



We are seeking an experienced AU Senior Accountant / Tax Reviewer & Team Leader with strong Australian public-practice experience and proven technical review and leadership capabilities.



This is a senior technical and supervisory position, not a routine tax preparation or data-entry role. The successful candidate must independently review accounting and taxation work, identify errors and compliance risks, supervise staff, manage deadlines and prepare complex work when required.



You will work closely with the Principal Accountant in Australia, ensuring high-quality work, accountability and continuous process improvement.



Key Responsibilities



- Independently prepare and review Australian financial statements and income tax returns for companies, trusts, partnerships and individuals.

- Apply strong technical knowledge of Australian taxation, including CGT, Division 7A, trust distributions, GST/BAS/IAS, depreciation and director/shareholder loan accounts.

- Prepare and review financial reports in accordance with applicable Australian Accounting Standards (AASB).

- Critically review accounting, bookkeeping, payroll, superannuation, balance-sheet reconciliations and supporting workpapers, identifying errors and ensuring corrections are completed.

- Undertake hands-on accounting, bookkeeping and reconciliations when required, including transactions involving e-commerce and payment platforms.

- Supervise accountants and bookkeepers, delegate tasks, monitor deadlines, provide review notes and ensure timely completion of work.

- Communicate directly with Australian clients and follow up outstanding information, accounting queries and compliance matters.

- Prepare and review management accounts, budgets, cash-flow forecasts, actual-versus-budget reports and variance analysis, providing meaningful financial insights.

- Mentor team members and improve accounting procedures, workflows, quality control and review processes.

- Use Xero, MYOB, Excel, AI and other accounting technologies effectively while maintaining professional judgement and confidentiality.

- Work closely with the Principal Accountant in Australia on complex technical matters, client issues, workflow management and practice development.

- Support the future growth of the Philippines team, including recruitment, training, systems implementation and potential office establishment.

- Be available for occasional international business travel, including Australia, when reasonably required.





What we are looking for



Minimum five years of hands-on Australian public-practice accounting and taxation experience, including proven experience independently reviewing financial statements, income tax returns and workpapers prepared by other accountants.



Accounting or related degree; CPA, CA or equivalent professional qualification highly regarded.



Strong practical knowledge of Australian taxation, including company and trust taxation, Division 7A, CGT, GST, depreciation and trust distributions.



Demonstrated ability to independently prepare and critically review company, trust, partnership and individual income tax returns, identifying errors, compliance risks and matters requiring further investigation.



Sound knowledge of Australian Accounting Standards (AASB), financial statement preparation, year-end adjustments and tax reconciliations.



Proven experience reviewing bookkeeping, balance-sheet reconciliations, financial statements and tax work, providing clear review notes and ensuring identified issues are satisfactorily resolved.



Strong proficiency in Xero and Australian tax preparation software. Experience with Xero Tax, Xero Practice Manager (XPM) and MYOB will be highly regarded.



Strong Excel skills, with experience in management reporting, budgeting, cash-flow forecasting and variance analysis considered an advantage.



Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to communicate directly with Australian clients and explain accounting and taxation matters professionally.



Demonstrated leadership and organisational skills, including the ability to delegate tasks, supervise junior accountants, monitor deadlines and follow up outstanding matters with staff and clients.



Strong technical judgement, attention to detail and the ability to distinguish between routine corrections and complex matters requiring escalation to the Principal Accountant.



A proactive, accountable and hands-on approach, with the ability to manage assigned work independently while assisting with accounting, bookkeeping, reconciliations and tax preparation when required.



Working Arrangement & Growth



The role will initially be remote and based in the Philippines.

As our Philippines operation grows, we may develop an office-based or hybrid team structure. The successful candidate may also take on broader leadership and operational responsibilities over time, with remuneration reviewed accordingly.



Recruitment Process



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid practical Australian accounting and taxation assessment before the final interview.



The assessment will focus on reviewing accounting records, reconciliations, financial statements, tax returns and supporting workpapers. Candidates will be expected to identify errors, provide review notes and demonstrate their ability to resolve issues or escalate complex matters appropriately.



This assessment is designed to evaluate practical experience, technical expertise, independent review capabilities, professional judgement and attention to detail.



Direct Applicants Only



We welcome applications from qualified individuals seeking a long-term career opportunity with our practice. We recruit directly and do not consider applications from recruitment agencies, outsourcing or staffing providers, subcontractors or third-party representatives.



All applicants are expected to participate personally in the recruitment process and complete their assessments independently.

title: Network Specialist
description:
Company: IT Connect Holdings

Location: Remote (Philippines / Kuala Lumpur - UTC+8)

Employment Type: Full-Time

About IT Connect

IT Connect is a premier provider of enterprise-class IT design, consulting, and assessment services. We specialise in providing effective IT managed solutions that reduce the total cost of ownership of client network environments while enhancing systems reliability and productivity.

Position Overview

We are seeking a full-time Remote Network Specialist based in the Philippines/Kuala Lumpur time zone to join our team. In this role, you will take ownership of network changes, client infrastructure maintenance, and escalated support. You will design, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain network environments across multi-tenant client sites using both GUI and CLI interfaces-ensuring solutions are secure, reliable, documented, and aligned with company standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Network Infrastructure & Security Management: Deploy, configure, and maintain business-class firewalls (Fortinet FortiGate, SonicWall, and Cisco), switches (Cisco, HP/Aruba), and wireless access points (APs).

• Firewall Policies & Access Controls: Create, audit, and optimize least-privilege firewall policies, NAT rules, network segmentation, site-to-site VPNs, and remote-access VPNs.

• Backup & Restoration Management: Establish, execute, and verify routine network configuration backup and restoration procedures to ensure rapid disaster recovery and business continuity.

• Escalation Support & Service Desk Collaboration: Act as an escalation point for Network Technicians and service desk staff. Resolve escalated tickets, perform root-cause diagnostics, and mentor junior technicians on networking concepts, troubleshooting methods, and documentation standards.

• Network Troubleshooting: Lead structured, evidence-based troubleshooting across Layers 1 through 7 (connectivity, routing, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, VPN, firewall, wireless, and performance) using packet captures, device logs, and network monitoring tools.

• Change Management & Planning: Develop implementation, testing, validation, and rollback plans prior to production network changes, leading scheduled maintenance windows to minimize client disruption.

• Documentation & Standards: Maintain accurate network standards, configuration templates, network topology diagrams, and as-built documentation following installations or major changes.

• Assessments & Migrations: Assist with network site assessments, infrastructure refreshes, hardware migrations, and new client onboardings.

Technical Knowledge & Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

• Certifications: CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate) or CCNP required; equivalent firewall certifications (e.g., Fortinet NSE 4+) are highly regarded.

• Vendor Experience: Hands-on experience configuring and managing:

o Firewalls: Cisco, Fortinet (FortiGate), and SonicWall.

o Switching & Wireless: Cisco and HP/Aruba switches, routers, and wireless access points.

• Interface Competency: Proven ability to manage network hardware fluently using both GUI and Command Line Interface (CLI) environments.

• Core Technical Knowledge:

o Practical knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4, subnetting, Ethernet, VLANs, trunking, Layer 2 switching, STP, static/dynamic routing, DHCP, and DNS.

o Deep understanding of NAT, firewall policies, network segmentation, VPNs (IPsec/SSL), and high availability/redundancy.

o Experience with packet capture tools (e.g., Wireshark), protocol analysis, log analysis, and network monitoring tools.

• Execution & Reliability: Demonstrated ability to independently deploy small client networks or major network components, plan production changes with rollback procedures, and execute backup/restoration procedures.

• Communication & Documentation: Excellent technical documentation skills and the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to technicians, management, and clients.

Nice-to-Have / Preferred Qualifications:

• MSP Experience: Prior experience working for a Managed Service Provider (MSP) managing multi-tenant client environments.

• Service Desk & PSA Tools: Familiarity with standard ticketing/PSA systems (e.g., HaloPSA, ConnectWise, Autotask, ServiceNow).

• Customer Service Orientation: Strong customer-first mindset with clear written and verbal English communication skills.

• Network Automation: Basic scripting or configuration management skills (e.g., Python, Ansible) to automate repetitive backup, configuration, or monitoring tasks.

Location & Working Hours

• Schedule: Full-Time – Monday to Friday (Some weekend work may be required for scheduled maintenance).

• Location: 100% Remote (Candidate based in the Philippines or Kuala Lumpur / UTC+8 time zone).

• Wages are in Canadian Dollars

• Shift Hours:

o Pacific Time (PT): 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM (Monday – Friday)

o Local Philippines / KL Time: 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM (Tuesday – Saturday morning)

o Overlap: 2-hour daily overlap with the Vancouver team from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM PT (6:00 AM to 8:00 AM local time).

o Note: Our Vancouver office observes daylight time year-round, so these working hours remain fixed throughout the year.

• Remote Setup Requirements: Dedicated home office space with reliable high-speed internet and backup power/internet connectivity.

title: Real Estate VP Technology Strategy and Innovation
description:
Reports to CEO and President

Works closely with the VP of Technology Operations and Systems Integration and Lead Management team; Operations; Agent Services; Marketing; Compliance; Finance; and external technology partners



Position Overview

YLN is creating this role to own both technology direction and portfolio delivery for its next stage of growth. The VP will translate the 2027 growth plan into an executable roadmap for platforms, data, AI, automation, security, staffing, and

investment. The role is accountable for priorities, capacity decisions, delivery commitments, and measurable business

results across the technology portfolio.



Role Distinction

This role has final accountability for enterprise technology priorities and delivery outcomes. Within approved budgets and

executive direction, the VP sets the roadmap, target architecture, sequence, deadlines, and capacity requirements. Zohaib

directs the team's daily work and assigns resources to approved priorities. When demand exceeds capacity, Zohaib

presents the constraint and options; this VP d
 what moves, what pauses, and what staffing is needed, escalating

budget or headcount decisions to the CEO and President.



Core Responsibilities and Area Accountability

1. 2027 Growth Roadmap - Own a multi-year roadmap tied to growth and revenue goals, with named owners, deadlines, dependencies, capacity, and staffing assumptions. Review delivery performance regularly and make timely priority or resource decisions when commitments are at risk.

2. Scalable Technology Stack - Own target architecture across Zillow Pro, Follow Up Boss, Ylopo, eRelocation, Biloco, and future tools. Before approval, assess effects on other departments, existing workflows, reporting, permissions, costs, support, and the agent and client experience.

3. AI and Automation - Work with department leaders to identify high-burden manual processes and prioritize practical AI or automation. Define the baseline, expected benefit, controls, owner, and adoption plan; check back after launch to confirm the change solved the problem.

4. Data Quality and Analytics - Own data definitions, reporting requirements, executive dashboards, and reporting priorities. Set standards and accountability for accurate, timely reports; use results to guide routing, nurture, staffing, and investment decisions while Zohaib owns report production and delivery.

5. Agent and Client Growth - Design technology that strengthens onboarding, partner service, agent productivity, and retention. Involve affected teams before changes are made, plan training and support, and validate afterward that workflows and the agent or client experience improved.

6. Vendor Governance and Budget - Own platform selection, contracts, strategic vendor calls, technology budget, licensing

policy, service levels, security, and vendor risk. Maintain accountability for technology spend and billing controls; Zohaib manages support calls, usage records, and invoice validation.

7. Cross Functional Leadership - Set portfolio priorities and delivery standards, direct work through the approved roadmap,

and hold leaders accountable for commitments. Lead impact reviews with Operations, Agent Services, Marketing, Compliance, Finance, and other teams before and after material changes.



Qualifications

• Senior technology leadership experience in a growing, lead-driven organization, with accountability for strategy,

architecture, budgets, staffing, vendors, and delivery results.

• Demonstrated success with CRM, marketing technology, multi-client environments, and API-based integrations;

experience with Follow Up Boss, Zillow, Ylopo, or eRelocation is strongly preferred.

• Practical experience deploying AI and automation with baselines, controls, adoption plans, and measurable results.

• Strong command of data governance, reporting, analytics, cybersecurity, privacy, access management, and change

governance.

• Clear executive communication and the ability to resolve competing priorities, capacity constraints, and cross-functional

impacts.

• Real estate, relocation, mortgage, or agent-network experience is preferred. A bachelor's degree in technology,

business, or a related field, or equivalent experience, is expected.

Success Measures

• A prioritized 2027 roadmap is actively managed with owners, deadlines, capacity, staffing assumptions, and clear

escalation paths.

• Portfolio commitments are delivered predictably, and capacity conflicts are resolved through explicit reprioritization,

staffing, or executive decisions.

• At least one high-burden manual process is improved within 90 days, with a documented baseline and measurable

result.

• Affected departments confirm that material changes improve workflows, reporting, permissions, or the agent and client

experience.

• Executive and recurring reports have defined owners, standards, schedules, and reliable source data.

• Technology vendors, contracts, billing, licensing, security, and access risks are reviewed on schedule and acted upon.

title: Remote Executive Assistants
description:
Position Overview:

At Ready Roles, we don’t just fill positions; we build lasting, impactful careers. As a Remote Executive Assistant, you will step into a critical role as a trusted “right arm” for an American business owner, making an essential difference in their day-to-day and long-term success. We are looking for driven, proactive individuals who don’t wait for instructions but actively seek opportunities to make an impact.





This role is for self-starters who thrive on finding solutions, tackling new challenges, and staying one step ahead of the business owner’s needs. Ready Roles carefully vets every client to ensure a respectful, growth-oriented work environment where your contributions are valued. We’re looking for someone ready to build a future, grow their skills, and commit to long-term success with their client.



 



Why Join Ready Roles?



 



A Career Path, Not Just a Job: This isn’t a stepping-stone; it’s a role designed for long-term growth. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to build a stable career with a supportive company that invests in their future.



Independence and Opportunity to Lead: Our clients want self-driven assistants who identify opportunities for improvement, find ways to make the business run smoothly, and drive the organization forward without needing to be told what to do. You’ll actively manage the business owner’s schedule and push organizational goals, not just your own tasks.



Respectful, Growth-Focused Clients: We only partner with clients who value stability and respect for their team. As a Ready Role, you’ll work with a business owner who is committed to your success and who shares a long-term vision for growth.



 



Key Responsibilities:



 



1. Daily Management and Proactive Support:

Calendar and Schedule Management: Oversee and prioritize the CEO’s calendar, blocking time for high-priority tasks, scheduling meetings, and ensuring the CEO is fully prepared for each day.






 and Communication Oversight: 

Sort, prioritize, and respond to
s and messages, filtering essential information to keep the CEO focused and eliminating routine communication distractions.



Daily Check-Ins and Task Planning: Conduct a daily check-in with the CEO to review priorities, set action items, and address any immediate needs, keeping both the CEO and the team on track.



2. Self-Directed Task Identification:



Identify Areas to Add Value: Proactively seek out tasks or projects that align with business goals, whether improving internal processes, coordinating with team members, or streamlining workflows.



Manage and Anticipate Owner’s Needs: Track ongoing projects, follow up on open items, and keep the CEO informed on key updates and deadlines without needing reminders ?.

Monitor and Report on KPIs: Track, organize, and report key performance indicators as part of regular updates for the CEO, helping to keep the business aligned with its growth goals.

4. Push Owner’s Priorities and Support Growth:

18 years old and above

description:

This is a client leadership role, not just support.

PAY
